needling: 一般層採直刺0.8～1.2寸。AD另列0.5～1寸；AD與醫砭的1.5～2寸因與AD所列椎管深度1.25～1.75寸重疊，只保留為來源衝突，不作常規深刺範圍。
needlingEn: The general layer uses perpendicular 0.8-1.2 cun. AD also lists 0.5-1 cun. The AD/Yibian 1.5-2-cun variants overlap AD's stated 1.25-1.75-cun spinal-canal depth and are retained only as a source conflict, not as a routine deep-insertion range.

location: 骶尾部後正中線，尾骨尖直上2寸。American Dragon 另列第二骶椎棘突下，屬未調和的來源定位變體。
locationEn: On the posterior midline of the sacrococcygeal region, 2 cun directly superior to the tip of the coccyx. American Dragon separately places it below the S2 spinous process; this remains an unreconciled source-location variant.
cunMeasurement: 尾骨尖直上2寸；後正中線。2 cun directly superior to the coccyx tip on the posterior midline.
anatomyZh: 醫砭精確頁列本穴在棘上韌帶中，附近有第二、第三骶動靜脈，並分布第二、第三骶神經後支。四層來源未提供皮膚至骶管、骶骨裂孔或其他深層結構的個體化距離。
anatomyEn: The exact Yibian page places the point in the supraspinous ligament and lists the second and third sacral arteries and veins and posterior branches of the second and third sacral nerves. The four source layers provide no individualized skin-to-sacral-canal, sacral-foramen, or other deep-structure distance.
acumethodZh: 一般層採 eLotus 的向上沿皮刺1～2寸。American Dragon 列向上斜刺2～2.5寸，醫砭列向上沿皮刺2～2.5寸，作較長來源變體分列。既有直刺0.3～0.8寸與點刺出血沒有在精確頁核實，退出可執行層但保留於來源缺口紀錄。
acumethodEn: The general layer uses eLotus's upward subcutaneous insertion of 1-2 cun. American Dragon lists upward oblique insertion 2-2.5 cun, and Yibian lists upward subcutaneous insertion 2-2.5 cun; these remain separately labeled longer variants. The legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods were not confirmed on the exact pages and are removed from the executable layer but preserved in the source-gap record.
moxaZh: eLotus 僅列可灸；American Dragon 與醫砭精確頁未提供本穴灸法。四層均無壯數、時間、直接／間接法、皮膚保護或停止規則，因此不補猜劑量。
moxaEn: eLotus only states that moxibustion is applicable; the exact American Dragon and Yibian pages provide no Yaoqi moxa method. None of the four layers supplies cone count, duration, direct/indirect method, skin protection, or stopping rules, so no dose is inferred.
techniqueNotes:
【一般層】向上沿皮刺1～2寸；eLotus 列可灸但無灸量。
【較長變體】AD 向上斜刺2～2.5寸；醫砭向上沿皮刺2～2.5寸。
【退出執行】舊卡直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血未獲精確頁支持。
General layer: upward subcutaneous insertion 1-2 cun; eLotus permits moxa but gives no dose. Longer variants: AD upward oblique and Yibian upward subcutaneous 2-2.5 cun. The legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and bloodletting methods lack exact-page support and are not executable.
functions: 鎮靜安神，熄風止痙（既有功能，癲癇主治支持但精確頁未列為獨立 action）
functionsEn: Calms the Shen; Pacifies Wind and stops spasms (legacy function supported by the seizure indication but not listed as a separate exact-page action)
functionsZhList: 熄風止痙（既有功能／主治推定）

exam_importance: 非 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列穴；本地 curriculum/acupoints 未找到專條。仍應辨識與十七椎、長強的定位差異及向上沿皮刺方向。
exam_importance_en: Not explicitly listed in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated entry was found in the local acupoint curriculum. Still distinguish it from Shiqizhui and Changqiang and remember the upward subcutaneous direction.
exam_pearl: 核心記憶：尾骨尖直上2寸、向上沿皮刺；但 AD 改列第二骶椎棘突下，定位衝突必須標來源。癲癇是主治，不代表可取代抗癲癇藥或急救。
exam_pearl_en: Core pearl: 2 cun superior to the coccyx tip, with upward subcutaneous insertion. AD instead places it below the S2 spinous process, so the location conflict must stay source-labeled. A seizure indication does not replace antiseizure medication or emergency care.
cautions: 【定位不可混同】eLotus／醫砭的尾骨尖直上2寸與 AD 的第二骶椎棘突下未能證明同點；觸診定位不清時不得以兩者互換。【方向與深度】精確頁一致要求向上沿皮／斜刺；沒有來源支持直向深刺。1～2寸與2～2.5寸須分列，不可合併為可自由選擇的1～2.5寸。【局部解剖】醫砭列第二、三骶血管及骶神經後支；顯著出血、尖銳電擊樣放射感、異常麻木無力或劇烈深痛應停止並評估。抗凝／抗血小板、凝血異常、骶尾外傷／畸形／感染／腫瘤或手術史，四源無專穴方案。【癲癇邊界】癲癇主治不代表治癒或可停抗癲癇藥；發作超過5分鐘、接連發作、呼吸／甦醒困難、受傷、水中發作、首次發作、孕期發作或糖尿病伴失去意識，依 CDC 應呼叫急救。【孕兒與灸法缺口】舊卡『孕婦慎用』無精確頁依據，不能升格為已核實禁忌；同樣也不能把來源沉默當作安全。四層沒有孕期、兒童或灸量方案。【舊技法缺口】舊直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血無精確頁支持，不執行。
cautionsEn: Do not conflate locations: the eLotus/Yibian location 2 cun above the coccyx tip and AD's location below the S2 spinous process were not shown to be identical. Do not substitute one for the other when landmarks are unclear.

Direction and depth: all exact pages specify upward subcutaneous/oblique insertion; no exact source supports deep perpendicular insertion. Keep 1-2 cun and 2-2.5 cun as separate source ranges rather than a freely interchangeable 1-2.5-cun span.

Local anatomy: Yibian lists the second/third sacral vessels and posterior sacral nerve branches. Stop and assess significant bleeding, sharp electric radiation, abnormal numbness or weakness, or severe deep pain. The four sources provide no point-specific protocol for anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, coagulopathy, sacrococcygeal trauma/deformity/infection/tumor, or prior surgery.

Epilepsy boundary: a seizure indication is not proof of cure and does not justify stopping antiseizure medication. CDC advises emergency help for a seizure lasting more than 5 minutes, repeated seizures, breathing or waking difficulty, injury, a seizure in water, a first seizure, a seizure during pregnancy, or loss of consciousness with diabetes.

Pregnancy/pediatric/moxa gap: the legacy 'caution in pregnancy' statement has no exact-page source and cannot be upgraded to a verified contraindication; source silence also cannot be treated as clearance. The four layers provide no pregnancy, pediatric, or moxa-dose protocol.
Legacy technique gap: the former perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods have no exact-page support and are not executable.
combinePointsZh: 【癲癇間歇期｜醫砭】腰奇＋鳩尾（CV15）＋神門（HT7）＋間使（PC5）＋筋縮（DU8）＋豐隆（ST40）＋大椎（DU14）＋風池（GB20）＋風府（DU16）＋百會（DU20）。【癲癇｜AD 交叉頁】Yaoqi 本頁配穴欄空白；AD 的陶道（DU13）頁列陶道＋腰奇＋水溝（DU26）＋內關（PC6）＋豐隆（ST40），長強（DU1）頁列長強＋腰奇＋癲癇（M-BW-36），巨闕（CV14）頁列巨闕＋大椎（DU14）＋水溝（DU26）＋腰奇＋內關（PC6）。上述只保留為來源配伍，不等同癲癇急救或停藥方案。
combinePointsEn: For the interictal stage of epilepsy, Yibian lists Yaoqi + Jiuwei (CV15) + Shenmen (HT7) + Jianshi (PC5) + Jinsuo (DU8) + Fenglong (ST40) + Dazhui (DU14) + Fengchi (GB20) + Fengfu (DU16) + Baihui (DU20). Yaoqi's own AD combination section is blank, but AD cross-pages list: Taodao (DU13) + Yaoqi + Shuigou (DU26) + Neiguan (PC6) + Fenglong (ST40); Changqiang (DU1) + Yaoqi + Dianxian (M-BW-36); and Juque (CV14) + Dazhui (DU14) + Shuigou (DU26) + Yaoqi + Neiguan (PC6). These are source-recorded combinations, not seizure first aid or medication-withdrawal plans.
clinical_pearls: eLotus：尾骨尖上2寸、癲癇／頭痛／失眠／便秘、安神、向上沿皮1～2寸、可灸。AD 精確頁只補 M-BW-29、Lower Back's Miscellany、S2棘突下、向上斜刺2～2.5寸與 seizures；actions／contraindications／本頁配穴皆空白，配穴須由 AD 其他精確穴頁交叉取得。醫砭補 EX-B9、命名、骶血管神經、2～2.5寸與癲癇間歇期配伍。Board 與本地課件均無專條。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus gives 2 cun above the coccyx tip; epilepsy, headache, insomnia, and constipation; calming the Shen; upward subcutaneous 1-2 cun; and moxa applicable. AD adds M-BW-29, Lower Back's Miscellany, a conflicting S2 location, upward oblique 2-2.5 cun, and seizures, while its actions, contraindications, and on-page combinations are blank; combinations come only from other exact AD point pages. Yibian adds EX-B9, name explanation, sacral vessels/nerves, 2-2.5 cun, and an interictal epilepsy combination. Neither the Board nor local curriculum has a dedicated entry.
nameIntroZh: 『腰奇』之『腰』指腰骶最下部，『奇』取資料所稱對便秘、頭痛、癲癇等有特殊應用之意。American Dragon 英譯 Lower Back's Miscellany；名稱含義不是療效保證。
nameIntroEn: Yao refers to the low lumbar-sacral region, while qi denotes the unusual or miscellaneous applications traditionally associated with constipation, headache, and epilepsy. American Dragon translates it as Lower Back's Miscellany; the name is not a guarantee of efficacy.
evidence:
四層整合：Yaoqi 不在 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列清單，本地 curriculum/acupoints 亦未找到專條。eLotus Ex-B9、American Dragon M-BW-29 精確頁與 AD 拼音索引均已開啟；醫砭 EX-B9 精確內容由精確 URL 的索引結果讀取，直接重開 cache miss。定位存在尾骨尖上2寸與 S2棘突下衝突；一般層採 eLotus 向上沿皮1～2寸，AD／醫砭2～2.5寸分列。舊直刺、放血與孕婦慎用均只保留為未核實舊值。CDC 僅提供癲癇急救邊界，不作穴位療效證據。
Four-layer synthesis: Yaoqi is not named in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. Exact eLotus Ex-B9 and AD M-BW-29 pages and the AD pinyin index were opened. Exact Yibian EX-B9 content was read from its precisely indexed URL; direct reopening cache-missed. The coccyx-tip and S2 locations conflict. The general layer uses eLotus's upward subcutaneous 1-2 cun, while AD/Yibian 2-2.5 cun remains separate. Legacy perpendicular needling, bloodletting, and pregnancy caution remain only as unverified historical card values. CDC supplies an emergency-care boundary, not point-efficacy evidence.

needling: 一般層採向上沿皮刺1～2寸。AD 向上斜刺2～2.5寸與醫砭向上沿皮刺2～2.5寸為較長來源變體；舊直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血未獲精確頁支持，不執行。
needlingEn: The general layer uses upward subcutaneous insertion 1-2 cun. AD's upward oblique 2-2.5 cun and Yibian's upward subcutaneous 2-2.5 cun remain longer source variants. The legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and bloodletting methods lack exact-page support and are not executable.

location: 背部後正中線，第4與第5胸椎棘突之間凹陷中（即第4胸椎棘突下）。
locationEn: On the posterior midline of the back, in the depression between the T4 and T5 spinous processes (immediately inferior to the T4 spinous process).
cunMeasurement: 無橫向寸量；以第4、5胸椎棘突間隙與後正中線定位。No transverse cun measurement; locate by the T4-T5 interspinous space on the posterior midline.
anatomyZh: 醫砭精確頁列本穴位於棘上韌帶與棘間韌帶處，附近有第4肋間後動脈背側支、棘間皮下靜脈叢及第4胸神經後支內側支。四層來源未提供個體化的皮膚至椎管或脊髓距離；CloudTCM 明確警示深刺可能傷及脊髓。
anatomyEn: The exact Yibian page places the point at the supraspinous and interspinous ligaments and lists the dorsal branch of the fourth posterior intercostal artery, the interspinous subcutaneous venous plexus, and the medial branch of the posterior ramus of the fourth thoracic nerve. The four source layers give no individualized skin-to-canal or skin-to-cord distance; CloudTCM explicitly warns that deep insertion may injure the spinal cord.
acumethodZh: 一般層採 eLotus 與 CloudTCM 的向上斜刺0.5～1.0寸；eLotus 另列得氣可達前胸與上腹、留針30分鐘。醫砭列直刺0.3～0.5寸，作方向與深度不同的來源變體分列，不與一般層合併。舊卡直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血未獲精確頁支持，退出可執行層但保留於來源缺口紀錄。
acumethodEn: The general layer uses eLotus and CloudTCM's upward-oblique insertion of 0.5-1.0 cun; eLotus additionally describes sensation reaching the anterior chest and upper abdomen and 30-minute retention. Yibian lists perpendicular insertion of 0.3-0.5 cun; this remains a separately labeled direction/depth variant rather than being merged with the general layer. The legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods lack exact-page support and are removed from the executable layer but preserved in the source-gap record.
moxaZh: eLotus 列灸5～15分鐘；CloudTCM 列艾炷3～7壯或溫和灸5～10分鐘；醫砭僅列可灸。古典『灸隨年壯』保留為歷史語句，不轉成現代兒童或成人劑量。來源未交代直接／間接法、皮膚保護、溫度或停止規則。
moxaEn: eLotus lists 5-15 minutes of moxibustion; CloudTCM lists 3-7 cones or 5-10 minutes of mild moxa; Yibian only states that moxibustion is applicable. The classical phrase 'cones according to age' is retained as a historical statement and is not converted into a modern pediatric or adult dose. The sources do not specify direct versus indirect technique, skin protection, temperature, or stopping rules.

exam_importance: 非 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列穴；本地 curriculum/acupoints 未找到專條。複習重點是第4、5胸椎棘突間、向上斜刺與椎管／脊髓深刺風險，並辨別本穴與任脈巨闕（CV14）不是同一穴。
exam_importance_en: Not explicitly listed in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. Review the T4-T5 interspinous location, upward-oblique direction, spinal-canal/cord risk of deep insertion, and the distinction from Juque (CV14) on the anterior midline.
exam_pearl: 核心記憶：四椎下、後正中線、向上斜刺；『俞』在背部，不可因拼音相近而誤套前正中線的巨闕 CV14。
exam_pearl_en: Core pearl: below T4, on the posterior midline, and needle obliquely upward. The back-point suffix shu distinguishes it from anterior-midline Juque (CV14); do not transfer CV14 content.
patterns: 心悸、心神不寧／神經衰弱
呃逆、噯氣／膈肌痙攣（CloudTCM 補充）
action_tags_en: Unbind the Chest and Regulate Qi
cautions: 【椎管／脊髓】本穴在T4～T5後正中線；CloudTCM 明列深刺可能傷及脊髓。一般層只採向上斜刺0.5～1.0寸，不把椎管當治療靶點，也不將醫砭直刺0.3～0.5寸與斜刺範圍混成自由選擇。【停止規則】尖銳電擊樣或異常軀幹／肢體放射感、突發麻木無力、劇烈深痛、阻力異常或顯著出血時停止並評估。【高風險背景】胸椎畸形／病變／感染／腫瘤、重大外傷、既往胸椎手術、抗凝／抗血小板、凝血異常或極端體型，四源無專穴調整方案。【急症邊界】胸痛、呼吸困難、冷汗、噁心、頭暈或快速／不規則心跳可能屬心臟急症；突發失語或言語不清可能屬中風，應依 AHA／ASA 警訊立即呼叫急救，不以本穴延誤評估。【孕兒缺口】舊卡『孕婦慎用』沒有精確頁支持，不能升格為已核實禁忌；來源沉默也不是安全許可。四層沒有孕期或兒童刺灸方案。【灸法與舊技法】各頁灸量不同，且無皮膚保護／停止規則；古典『隨年壯』不可直接換算。舊點刺出血無精確頁支持，不執行。
cautionsEn: Spinal canal/cord: this point lies on the T4-T5 posterior midline, and CloudTCM explicitly warns that deep insertion may injure the spinal cord. The general layer uses only upward-oblique insertion of 0.5-1.0 cun, never treats the canal as a target, and does not merge Yibian's perpendicular 0.3-0.5-cun variant into a freely interchangeable range.
Stopping rules: stop and assess sharp electric or abnormal trunk/limb radiation, sudden numbness or weakness, severe deep pain, unusual resistance, or significant bleeding.

High-risk context: thoracic-spine deformity/disease/infection/tumor, major trauma, prior thoracic-spine surgery, anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy, coagulopathy, or extreme body habitus requires individualized assessment; none of the four source layers supplies a point-specific adjustment protocol.

Emergency boundary: chest pain with dyspnea, cold sweat, nausea, lightheadedness, or rapid/irregular heartbeat can indicate a cardiac emergency; sudden aphasia or speech difficulty can indicate stroke. Follow AHA/ASA warning signs and call emergency services rather than delaying evaluation for this point.

Pregnancy/pediatric gap: the legacy 'caution in pregnancy' statement has no exact-page support and cannot be upgraded to a verified contraindication; source silence is not clearance. The four layers provide no pregnancy- or pediatric-specific needling/moxa protocol.

Moxa/legacy-technique gap: exact pages give differing moxa doses without skin-protection or stopping rules, and the classical 'cones according to age' phrase cannot be directly converted into a modern dose. The legacy prick-to-bleed method lacks exact-page support and is not executable.
combinePointsZh: 【心痛｜醫砭】巨闕俞＋心俞（BL15）＋間使（PC5）＋內關（PC6）＋大陵（PC7）＋曲澤（PC3）。【胸膈脹滿｜醫砭】巨闕俞＋膈俞（BL17）＋中脘（CV12）＋足三里（ST36）。【其他來源配伍｜MedicalTeaching】心脾兩虛之健忘心悸：巨闕俞＋心俞（BL15）＋脾俞（BL20）＋百會（DU20）＋陰陵泉（SP9）＋內關（PC6）；心腎不交失眠：巨闕俞＋神門（HT7）＋心俞（BL15）＋三陰交（SP6）＋腎俞（BL23）＋太溪（KI3）；咳嗽：巨闕俞＋中府（LU1）＋肺俞（BL13）＋尺澤（LU5）＋列缺（LU7）；寒喘：巨闕俞＋肺俞（BL13）＋風門（BL12）＋孔最（LU6）＋內關（PC6）。以上為來源記錄，不取代胸痛、中風或呼吸窘迫的急症處置。
combinePointsEn: For heart pain, Yibian lists Juqueshu + Xinshu (BL15) + Jianshi (PC5) + Neiguan (PC6) + Daling (PC7) + Quze (PC3). For chest/diaphragm distention and fullness, Yibian lists Juqueshu + Geshu (BL17) + Zhongwan (CV12) + Zusanli (ST36). MedicalTeaching additionally records: for Heart-Spleen deficiency with poor memory/palpitations, Juqueshu + BL15 + BL20 + DU20 + SP9 + PC6; for Heart-Kidney disharmony insomnia, Juqueshu + HT7 + BL15 + SP6 + BL23 + KI3; for cough, Juqueshu + LU1 + BL13 + LU5 + LU7; and for cold-pattern wheezing, Juqueshu + BL13 + BL12 + LU6 + PC6. These source-recorded combinations do not replace emergency care for chest pain, stroke, or respiratory distress.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 精確頁提供定位、全套主治、兩項 actions、向上斜刺0.5～1寸、留針30分鐘、灸5～15分鐘與三個別名。American Dragon 拼音索引已檢索 Juqueshu／Juque，未找到本穴；猜測頁 /Points/Juqueshu.html 無法開啟，且 CV14 Juque 不是本穴。醫砭補解剖、直刺0.3～0.5寸變體與兩組配伍；CloudTCM 補理宗氣／通督陽、呃逆噯氣、3～7壯或5～10分鐘溫和灸及深刺傷脊髓警語。Board 與本地課件均無專條。
clinical_pearls_en: The exact eLotus page supplies the location, full indication set, two actions, upward-oblique 0.5-1-cun method, 30-minute retention, 5-15-minute moxa, and three aliases. The American Dragon pinyin index was searched for Juqueshu and Juque but contains no entry for this back point; the guessed /Points/Juqueshu.html page did not open, and CV14 Juque is not this point. Yibian adds anatomy, a perpendicular 0.3-0.5-cun variant, and two combinations. CloudTCM adds regulation of Zong Qi/coursing Du Yang, hiccup and belching, 3-7 cones or 5-10 minutes of mild moxa, and the spinal-cord injury warning. Neither the Board nor local curriculum has a dedicated entry.
nameIntroZh: 『巨闕俞』之名以『巨闕』指胸中／心胸相關傳統應用，『俞』表位於背部輸注之處。eLotus 英譯 Great Palace of Qi Transformation，並列心舒2、回春、四椎下等別名；名稱含義不是療效保證。
nameIntroEn: In Juqueshu, Juque traditionally evokes the chest/Heart sphere and shu denotes a transporting point on the back. eLotus translates the name as Great Palace of Qi Transformation and lists Heart Comfort 2, Return to Youth, and Below the Fourth Vertebra as aliases; the name is not a guarantee of efficacy.
evidence:
四層整合：Juqueshu 不在 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列清單，本地 curriculum/acupoints 未找到專條。eLotus 精確頁已開啟，但標 Ex-B14；醫砭精確索引內容標 EX-B11；資料庫 EX-B10／ex.b10 依不可變識別規則保留，差異不強行調和。American Dragon 拼音索引已開啟並檢索，未找到 Juqueshu，猜測精確頁亦無法開啟，因此不移植 CV14 Juque 內容。CloudTCM 與 MedicalTeaching 精確 URL 的索引內容作補充。技法一般層採 eLotus／CloudTCM 向上斜刺0.5～1寸，醫砭直刺0.3～0.5寸分列；舊放血及孕婦慎用只保留為未核實舊值。AHA／ASA 僅提供急症分流邊界，不作穴位療效證據。
Four-layer synthesis: Juqueshu is not named in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus page was opened but labels the point Ex-B14; indexed exact Yibian content labels it EX-B11. Database identity EX-B10/ex.b10 is preserved under the immutable-ID rule and the discrepancy is not forced into false consensus. The American Dragon pinyin index was opened and searched without finding Juqueshu; the guessed exact page also failed, so no CV14 Juque content is transferred. Indexed exact CloudTCM and MedicalTeaching URLs supplement the card. The general technique layer uses eLotus/CloudTCM upward-oblique 0.5-1 cun, while Yibian perpendicular 0.3-0.5 cun remains separate. Legacy bloodletting and pregnancy caution remain only as unverified old values. AHA/ASA supplies emergency-triage boundaries, not point-efficacy evidence.

needlingEn: General layer: upward-oblique insertion 0.5-1.0 cun. Yibian's perpendicular 0.3-0.5-cun method remains a separately labeled variant. Legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods lack exact-page support and are not executable.

location: 背部後正中線，第12胸椎與第1腰椎棘突之間凹陷中（即第12胸椎棘突下）。
locationEn: On the posterior midline of the back, in the depression between the T12 and L1 spinous processes (immediately inferior to the T12 spinous process).
cunMeasurement: 無橫向寸量；以第12胸椎與第1腰椎棘突間隙、胸腰交界及後正中線定位。No transverse cun measurement; locate by the T12-L1 interspinous space at the thoracolumbar junction on the posterior midline.
anatomyZh: MedicalTeaching 精確頁列皮膚、皮下組織、棘上韌帶及棘間韌帶；淺層有第12胸神經後支內側皮支及伴行血管，深層有椎外後靜脈叢、第12胸神經後支分支及第12肋間後動靜脈背側支。此處接近胸腰交界；Merck 列成人脊髓通常終於L1～L2形成脊髓圓錐，因此來源未給皮膚至椎管／脊髓圓錐的個體化距離時，不得把正中線深刺視為安全。
anatomyEn: The exact MedicalTeaching page lists skin, subcutaneous tissue, supraspinous ligament, and interspinous ligament; superficially it lists the medial cutaneous branch of the T12 posterior ramus and accompanying vessels, and deeply the posterior external vertebral venous plexus, branches of the T12 posterior ramus, and dorsal branches of the twelfth posterior intercostal vessels. This is the thoracolumbar junction. Merck states that the adult spinal cord usually ends at L1-L2 as the conus medullaris; without an individualized skin-to-canal/conus distance, deep midline insertion cannot be presumed safe.
acumethodZh: 一般層採 eLotus、CloudTCM 與 MedicalTeaching 的向上斜刺0.5～1.0寸；MedicalTeaching 另列局部痠麻脹感及留針30分鐘。其同頁亦引《中國針灸學》『禁刺』，與現代針法構成未調和的歷史安全衝突，必須保留。舊卡直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血未獲精確頁支持，退出可執行層。
acumethodEn: The general layer uses the upward-oblique 0.5-1.0-cun method shared by eLotus, CloudTCM, and MedicalTeaching; MedicalTeaching additionally describes local aching/numbness/distention and 30-minute retention. The same page quotes a historical Chinese Acupuncture source that prohibits needling, creating an unresolved historical safety conflict that must remain visible. The legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods lack exact-page support and are removed from the executable layer.
moxaZh: eLotus 列灸5～10分鐘；CloudTCM 列1～3壯或溫和灸5～10分鐘；MedicalTeaching 列5～7壯或溫灸5～15分鐘，並引古典小兒痢疾／脫肛用麥粒大艾炷1壯。壯數與時間各依原來源分列；古典小兒劑量不轉成現代兒科方案。來源未提供直接／間接法、皮膚保護、溫度及停止規則。
moxaEn: eLotus lists 5-10 minutes; CloudTCM lists 1-3 cones or 5-10 minutes of mild moxa; MedicalTeaching lists 5-7 cones or 5-15 minutes of warm moxa and quotes a classical one-wheat-grain-sized-cone method for pediatric dysentery/rectal prolapse. Cone counts and time ranges remain source-specific; the historical pediatric dose is not converted into a modern pediatric protocol. The sources do not provide direct/indirect method, skin protection, temperature, or stopping rules.

exam_importance_en: Not explicitly listed in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. Recognize the location below T12, Jieji as the primary name with Jiegu as an alias, and that the sourced indication core is digestive/pediatric rather than fracture reduction or healing.
exam_pearl: 核心記憶：T12～L1後正中線；『接脊』不是『接骨折』。名稱別名容易造成把未證實的骨折主治誤塞入卡片。
exam_pearl_en: Core pearl: posterior midline at T12-L1. Jieji means Connecting Vertebrae; the alias Jiegu must not be misread as proof that the point treats or unites fractures.

Strengthen the Spleen and Harmonize the Stomach
cautions: 【脊髓圓錐／椎管】本穴位於T12～L1後正中線；成人脊髓通常至L1～L2形成脊髓圓錐，來源未提供個體化皮膚至椎管距離。只保留現代精確頁的向上斜刺0.5～1寸，不把椎管當靶點；同頁所引歷史『禁刺』必須作未調和安全衝突保留。【停止規則】尖銳電擊樣或異常軀幹／下肢放射感、突發麻木無力、劇烈深痛、阻力異常、大小便控制改變或顯著出血時停止並立即評估。【高風險背景】胸腰椎畸形／感染／腫瘤／外傷、既往手術、抗凝／抗血小板、凝血異常或極端體型，四源無專穴調整方案。【兒科與癲癇】小兒痢疾、脫肛、癲癇／驚風是主治記錄，不是兒童刺灸安全許可；古典麥粒大1壯不可直接套入現代兒童。發作超過5分鐘、接連發作、呼吸／甦醒困難、受傷、水中或首次發作等依 CDC 呼叫急救。【骨折邊界】『接骨』是別名；骨折痛與續筋接骨僅為未核實舊卡值。疑似骨折或脊柱創傷依 Mayo 應保持不動並求醫，不以本穴替代影像、復位、固定或急救。【孕期與灸法缺口】舊卡孕婦慎用無精確頁支持，不能升格為已核實禁忌；來源沉默也不是許可。各頁灸量不一且無皮膚保護／停止規則。舊點刺出血不執行。
cautionsEn: Conus/canal: the point lies on the T12-L1 posterior midline, and the adult spinal cord usually ends at L1-L2 as the conus medullaris. Exact sources provide no individualized skin-to-canal distance. Retain only the modern exact pages' upward-oblique 0.5-1-cun method, never target the canal, and preserve the quoted historical prohibition on needling as an unresolved safety conflict.

Stopping rules: stop and urgently assess sharp electric or abnormal trunk/lower-limb radiation, sudden numbness or weakness, severe deep pain, unusual resistance, change in bladder/bowel control, or significant bleeding.

High-risk context: thoracolumbar deformity/infection/tumor/trauma, prior surgery, anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy, coagulopathy, or extreme body habitus requires individualized assessment; none of the four layers supplies a point-specific adjustment protocol.

Pediatrics/seizures: pediatric dysentery, prolapse, epilepsy, and convulsions are indication records, not pediatric needling/moxa clearance. Do not convert the classical one-wheat-grain-sized-cone instruction into a modern pediatric dose. CDC emergency criteria apply to prolonged, repeated, first, injured, water-related, pregnancy-related, or breathing/recovery-complicated seizures.

Fracture boundary: Jiegu is an alias; fracture pain and bone-healing actions are unverified legacy values. For suspected fracture or spinal trauma, Mayo advises keeping the person still and obtaining medical care; this point does not replace imaging, reduction, immobilization, or emergency care.

Pregnancy/moxa/legacy gap: the legacy pregnancy caution has no exact-page support and cannot be upgraded to a verified contraindication; source silence is not clearance. Moxa doses differ and lack skin-protection/stopping rules. Legacy prick-to-bleed is not executable.
combinePointsZh: 【脫肛｜MedicalTeaching】接脊＋百合穴（來源原文；穴名／代碼未能標準化）＋長強（DU1）＋承山（BL57）。【痢疾｜MedicalTeaching】接脊＋天樞（ST25）＋上巨虛（ST37）。【癲癇｜MedicalTeaching】接脊＋腰奇（EX-B9）＋申脈（BL62）＋照海（KI6）＋大椎（DU14）＋後溪（SI3）。【腰痛｜MedicalTeaching】接脊＋相應夾脊＋水溝（DU26）。以上為來源記錄；未標準化的『百合穴』不擅自改作百會，且配伍不等同兒科、癲癇或脊柱急症方案。
combinePointsEn: For rectal prolapse, MedicalTeaching lists Jieji + Baihe point (the source wording could not be standardized to a verified point/code) + Changqiang (DU1) + Chengshan (BL57). For dysentery: Jieji + Tianshu (ST25) + Shangjuxu (ST37). For epilepsy: Jieji + Yaoqi (EX-B9) + Shenmai (BL62) + Zhaohai (KI6) + Dazhui (DU14) + Houxi (SI3). For low-back pain: Jieji + corresponding Jiaji points + Shuigou (DU26). The unstandardized 'Baihe point' is not silently changed to Baihui, and these combinations are not pediatric, seizure, or spinal-emergency protocols.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 精確頁的實際主名為接脊 Jieji／Connecting Vertebrae、代碼 Ex-B15；提供T12～L1定位、完整消化／小兒／神經主治、消食止痛、向上斜刺0.5～1寸及灸5～10分鐘。American Dragon 拼音索引檢索 Jieji／Jiegu 均無結果，兩個猜測頁皆無法開啟。CloudTCM 精確頁確認接骨為別名並補1～3壯或5～10分鐘；MedicalTeaching 補詳細解剖、留針、主治、配伍與『古代偏灸、部分教材禁針』衝突。Board 與本地課件均無專條。
clinical_pearls_en: The exact eLotus page uses Jieji/Connecting Vertebrae as the primary name and Ex-B15 as its code; it supplies the T12-L1 location, full digestive/pediatric/neurologic indications, digestion/pain action, upward-oblique 0.5-1-cun method, and 5-10-minute moxa. The American Dragon pinyin index has no Jieji or Jiegu result, and both guessed detail pages failed. The exact CloudTCM page confirms Jiegu as an alias and adds 1-3 cones or 5-10 minutes. MedicalTeaching adds detailed anatomy, retention, expanded indications, combinations, and the conflict between modern needling and historically moxa-only/no-needle teaching. Neither Board nor local curriculum has a dedicated entry.
nameIntroZh: 『接脊』之『接』有連接之意，『脊』指胸腰椎交界；eLotus 英譯 Connecting Vertebrae。『接骨』是資料所列別名，不表示本穴已被證實可接續骨折。
nameIntroEn: Jie means to connect and ji refers to the spine at the thoracolumbar junction; eLotus translates it as Connecting Vertebrae. Jiegu/Connecting Bone is a recorded alias, not evidence that the point unites fractures.
evidence:
四層整合：Jieji 不在 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列清單，本地 curriculum/acupoints 未找到專條。eLotus 精確頁已開啟，主名接脊、代碼 Ex-B15；日本考試資料亦以接脊為主名、接骨為別名。資料庫 `EX-B11`／`ex.b11` 保留，但主名由舊卡接骨 Jiegu 校正為接脊（接骨）Jieji。另有低權威頁標 EX-B07，編碼衝突不強行調和。American Dragon 拼音索引已開啟並搜尋 Jieji／Jiegu，兩個名字均不存在，猜測頁也無法開啟。CloudTCM `dic/5720` 與 MedicalTeaching 精確頁補充內容。舊骨折疼痛、續筋接骨、直刺、放血與孕婦慎用均只保留為未核實舊值。Merck、Mayo、CDC 僅提供解剖與急症邊界，不作穴位療效證據。
Four-layer synthesis: Jieji is not named in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus page was opened and uses Jieji/Connecting Vertebrae with code Ex-B15; Japanese exam-oriented material also treats Jieji as primary and Jiegu as an alias. Database `EX-B11`/`ex.b11` is preserved, while the legacy primary name Jiegu is corrected to Jieji (Jiegu). A lower-authority page uses EX-B07; the code conflict is not forced into false consensus. The American Dragon pinyin index was opened and searched for Jieji/Jiegu without either name, and both guessed pages failed. Exact CloudTCM `dic/5720` and MedicalTeaching pages supplement the content. Legacy fracture pain, bone-healing action, perpendicular needling, bloodletting, and pregnancy caution remain only as unverified old values. Merck, Mayo, and CDC supply anatomy/emergency boundaries, not point-efficacy evidence.

needling: 一般層向上斜刺0.5～1.0寸；同一補充來源另引歷史禁針，屬未調和安全衝突。舊直刺0.3～0.8寸及點刺出血未獲精確頁支持，不執行。
needlingEn: General layer: upward-oblique insertion 0.5-1.0 cun. The same supplemental source also quotes a historical prohibition on needling, an unresolved safety conflict. Legacy perpendicular 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods lack exact-page support and are not executable.

location: 定位有未調和差異：舊卡置於臀部，大轉子與骶骨角連線的中1/3與下1/3交界；American Dragon 精確頁則置於大轉子與尾骨連線中點下1寸。兩者骶側地標與比例不同，不視為同一定位。
locationEn: An unresolved location discrepancy remains. The legacy card places the point in the gluteal region at the junction of the middle and lower thirds of the line from the greater trochanter to the sacral hiatus; the exact American Dragon page places it 1 cun inferior to the midpoint of the line from the greater trochanter to the coccyx. The sacral-side landmark and proportion differ and are not treated as equivalent.
cunMeasurement: AD：大轉子至尾骨連線中點下1寸。舊卡：大轉子至骶骨角連線中、下1/3交界。AD: 1 cun below the midpoint of the greater-trochanter-to-coccyx line. Legacy: junction of the middle and lower thirds of the greater-trochanter-to-sacral-hiatus line.
anatomyZh: 本穴位於深臀區。區域解剖文獻顯示，坐骨神經在梨狀肌下方進入深臀間隙，深於臀大肌，並向坐骨結節與大轉子之間走行；周圍尚有臀下血管神經與股後皮神經等結構。這些是區域解剖，不是 EX-B12 的個體化針路。AD 只記局部痠脹或電麻感可達小腿，未提供皮膚至神經／血管距離、安全終點或體型修正。
anatomyEn: This point is in the deep gluteal region. Regional anatomical literature places the sciatic nerve inferior to the piriformis, deep to gluteus maximus, and coursing toward the interval between the ischial tuberosity and greater trochanter; the inferior gluteal neurovascular structures and posterior femoral cutaneous nerve are also regional considerations. This is regional anatomy, not an individualized EX-B12 needle path. AD only records local distention/soreness or an electric-numb sensation reaching the lower leg and gives no skin-to-nerve/vessel distance, safe endpoint, or body-habitus adjustment.
acumethodZh: American Dragon 精確頁：直刺2～3寸，可有局部脹痠，偶見電麻感延至小腿；頁面未列針具長度、體型修正、神經接觸判準或停止規則。舊卡另有直刺1.5～2.5寸，但未找到可核讀的具名來源；舊0.3～0.8寸與點刺出血也無精確頁支持，均保留為歷史值而不併入 AD 技法。
acumethodEn: Exact American Dragon page: straight insertion 2-3 cun, with local distention and soreness and sometimes an electric-numb sensation reaching the lower leg; the page supplies no needle-length requirement, body-habitus adjustment, nerve-contact criterion, or stopping rule. The legacy card also gives perpendicular insertion 1.5-2.5 cun without a reviewable named source. The older 0.3-0.8-cun and prick-to-bleed methods likewise lack exact-page support; all legacy variants remain documented but are not merged into the AD method.
moxaZh: 舊卡僅記『可灸』，但 Board、課件、eLotus 索引與 AD 坐骨專頁均未提供本穴的灸法、時間、壯數、直接／間接法、皮膚保護或停止規則；不把舊記載擴寫成可執行劑量。
moxaEn: The legacy card only states that moxibustion is applicable. combinePointsZh:
【坐骨神經痛｜AD 坐骨專頁】坐骨＋殷門（BL37）＋陽陵泉（GB34）。
【坐骨神經痛｜AD 病症頁】陽陵泉（GB34）＋殷門（BL37）＋坐骨；另列環跳（GB30）或坐骨作選穴。
【腰腿痛｜AD 承扶頁】關元俞（BL26）＋坐骨（N-BW-17）＋委中（BL40）。以上為 AD 來源記錄；原頁未提供配伍機理、側別或療程，不自行補寫。
combinePointsEn: For sciatica, the AD Zuogu page lists Zuogu + Yinmen (BL37) + Yanglingquan (GB34). The AD sciatica page also lists GB34 + BL37 + Zuogu and separately offers Huantiao (GB30) or Zuogu as a point choice. For low-back and leg pain, the AD Chengfu page lists Guanyuanshu (BL26) + Zuogu (N-BW-17) + Weizhong (BL40). The source gives no pairing mechanism, laterality, or treatment course, so none is invented.
cautions: 【坐骨神經與深臀結構】區域解剖顯示坐骨神經深於臀大肌、經深臀間隙向大轉子與坐骨結節之間走行；AD 的2～3寸直刺與電麻感延至小腿記載未附皮膚至神經／血管距離、安全終點或體型修正，不能把『電麻到小腿』概括成必須追求的針感。【定位／深度衝突】舊卡定位使用骶骨角與三等分，AD 使用尾骨與中點下1寸；舊1.5～2.5寸、0.3～0.8寸及 AD 2～3寸不得合併成寬泛自由範圍。【神經紅旗】AD 雖在主治欄列『下肢癱瘓』，本卡不把癱瘓或急性神經缺損升格為療效證據。新發或進行性單／雙下肢無力或癱瘓、鞍區感覺異常、膀胱或腸道功能改變，應緊急評估，不以穴位治療延誤。【高風險與特殊族群缺口】四層未提供臀部手術／植入物、腫塊、血腫、感染、抗凝／凝血異常、極端體型、孕期或兒童的專穴調整方案；舊『孕婦慎用』無精確頁支持，來源沉默也不是安全許可。【舊技法】點刺出血與可灸只有未核實舊值，無出血量、止血、灸量或皮膚保護規範，不作可執行方案。
cautionsEn: Sciatic nerve/deep gluteal structures: regional anatomy places the sciatic nerve deep to gluteus maximus in the deep gluteal space as it travels toward the interval between the greater trochanter and ischial tuberosity. AD's 2-3-cun insertion and electric-numb sensation to the lower leg come without a skin-to-nerve/vessel distance, safe endpoint, or body-habitus adjustment; the distal electric sensation must not be generalized as a required target.

Location/depth conflict: the legacy card uses the sacral hiatus and thirds, whereas AD uses the coccyx and 1 cun below the midpoint. Legacy 1.5-2.5 cun, legacy 0.3-0.8 cun, and AD 2-3 cun must not be merged into a broad freely interchangeable range.

Neurologic red flags: although AD lists lower-limb paralysis under indications, this card does not promote paralysis or an acute neurologic deficit as efficacy evidence. New or progressive unilateral/bilateral leg weakness or paralysis, saddle sensory change, or bladder/bowel dysfunction requires urgent assessment rather than delay for point treatment.

High-risk/special-population gap: the four layers provide no point-specific adjustment for prior gluteal surgery or implants, mass, hematoma, infection, anticoagulation/coagulopathy, extreme body habitus, pregnancy, or pediatrics. The legacy pregnancy caution lacks exact-page support, and source silence is not clearance.

Legacy-technique gap: prick-to-bleed and moxa applicability survive only as unverified legacy values, with no bleeding quantity, hemostasis, moxa dose, or skin-protection protocol; they are not executable instructions.
clinical_pearls: American Dragon 的坐骨精確頁可直接開啟，正文代碼 N-BW-17，提供大轉子—尾骨線中點下1寸、直刺2～3寸、局部脹痠或電麻至小腿、坐骨神經痛、來源所稱下肢癱瘓，以及殷門＋陽陵泉配伍；其中『下肢癱瘓』不收入本卡療效／主治陣列，只保留於神經急症邊界。AD 搜尋標題顯 M-BW-17，屬站內代碼不一致。eLotus production 索引未找到 Zuogu／坐骨；Board 與本地課件亦無專條。AD 坐骨神經痛與承扶頁補兩組坐骨相關配伍；深臀區文獻只用於解剖風險邊界，不作穴位療效或刺深證據。
clinical_pearls_en: The exact American Dragon Zuogu page opened directly. Its body uses N-BW-17 and supplies the location 1 cun below the midpoint of the greater-trochanter-to-coccyx line, straight insertion 2-3 cun, local distention/soreness or electric numbness to the lower leg, sciatica, a source-stated lower-limb-paralysis claim, and a BL37+GB34 combination. The paralysis claim is excluded from the card's efficacy/indication arrays and retained only at the neurologic-emergency boundary. AD search-title metadata instead shows M-BW-17, an internal code inconsistency. No Zuogu/坐骨 entry was found in the production eLotus index, and neither Board nor local curriculum has a dedicated entry. AD's sciatica and Chengfu pages add two Zuogu-related combinations; deep-gluteal literature supplies only the anatomical risk boundary, not efficacy or point-depth evidence.
nameIntroZh: 『坐骨』直指臀部坐骨／承重區域；AD 英文欄寫 Ischeum，應是 ischium 的非標準拼寫。本穴名稱與深臀位置相呼應，但不表示針尖應接觸坐骨或坐骨神經。
nameIntroEn: Zuogu literally refers to the sitting bone/ischial region. AD writes 'Ischeum,' a nonstandard spelling of ischium. The name fits the deep gluteal location but does not mean that the needle should contact the ischium or sciatic nerve.
evidence:
四層整合：Zuogu 不在 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列清單，本地 curriculum/acupoints 無坐骨專條。eLotus production 索引已開啟並搜尋 Zuogu／坐骨，未找到專頁，因此不假設其代碼、定位或刺法。American Dragon 精確頁已開啟，正文標 N-BW-17，提供尾骨定位、直刺2～3寸、針感、坐骨神經痛、來源所稱下肢癱瘓與配伍；搜尋標題 M-BW-17 的站內差異保留。下肢癱瘓不收入療效／主治陣列，只作神經急症邊界。AD 病症頁與承扶頁補坐骨相關配伍。舊卡的骶骨角定位、直刺1.5～2.5寸、舒筋通絡／利腰腿、臀痛、0.3～0.8寸、點刺出血、可灸及孕婦慎用均保留並標示證據層級，未與 AD 合併。深臀區解剖與馬尾警訊來源只限制安全與分流，不作本穴療效證據。
Four-layer synthesis: Zuogu is not explicitly named in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The production eLotus index was opened and searched for Zuogu/坐骨 without finding a detail entry, so no eLotus code, location, or technique is inferred. The exact American Dragon page opened and uses N-BW-17 in the body, supplying the coccyx-based location, straight insertion 2-3 cun, sensation, sciatica, a source-stated lower-limb-paralysis claim, and a combination; its M-BW-17 search-title discrepancy is preserved. Lower-limb paralysis is excluded from the efficacy/indication arrays and used only as a neurologic-emergency boundary. AD's sciatica and Chengfu pages add Zuogu-related combinations. Legacy sacral-hiatus location, 1.5-2.5-cun depth, sinew/channel actions, gluteal pain, 0.3-0.8-cun depth, bloodletting, moxa, and pregnancy caution remain visible with their evidence level and are not merged into AD content. Deep-gluteal anatomy and cauda-equina warning sources constrain safety/triage only and are not efficacy evidence.

locationEn: With the elbow flexed, at the highest prominence of the ulnar olecranon; the exact eLotus and American Dragon pages agree on this landmark.
cunMeasurement: 本穴以尺骨鷹嘴骨性標誌取穴，不使用寸量。 This point is located by the olecranon bony landmark rather than a cun measurement.
anatomyZh: 表面標誌為尺骨鷹嘴尖端。四層精確來源未提供皮下層次、鷹嘴滑囊厚度、皮膚至骨膜距離或體型修正；因此不把骨性標誌推論成可針刺深度。
anatomyEn: The surface landmark is the tip of the ulnar olecranon. The exact four-layer sources provide no tissue-layer description, olecranon-bursa thickness, skin-to-periosteum distance, or body-habitus adjustment; the bony landmark is therefore not converted into an inferred needling depth.
acumethodZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 精確頁均明列『只灸』。舊卡另有直刺0.3～0.5寸或點刺出血，與兩個精確頁不一致且缺乏精確來源支持，僅保留為未核實 legacy，不作可執行技法。
acumethodEn: The exact eLotus and American Dragon pages both state moxibustion only. Legacy perpendicular insertion of 0.3-0.5 cun or prick-to-bleed differs from both exact pages and lacks exact-source support; it is retained only as unverified legacy, not as an executable method.

combinePointsZh: 四層精確來源未提供肘尖專屬配穴。舊卡亦無配穴內容；不以其他穴位治療瘰癧、癰腫或腸癰的組方移植到本穴。
combinePointsEn: The exact four-layer sources provide no Zhoujian-specific combination. The legacy card also has no combination content; combinations for scrofula, carbuncles, or intestinal abscess involving other points are not transferred to this point.
cautions: 【灸法邊界】eLotus 與 AD 均只寫『只灸』，沒有直接／間接法、壯數、皮膚保護、熱傷害停止規則或兒童方案；舊7～15壯不得升格為可執行劑量。【針刺／放血衝突】舊直刺0.3～0.5寸與點刺出血和兩個精確頁不一致，且無精確頁支持，不執行也不合併；舊『注意手指清潔消毒』所指技法不清，不能取代放血安全規範。【急症邊界】舊『腸癰』不等同已證實的闌尾炎療效；NIDDK 將疑似闌尾炎列為需立即處理的醫療急症。【特殊族群缺口】四層未提供孕期、兒童、感覺障礙、皮膚脆弱、抗凝／凝血異常的專穴方案；來源沉默不是安全許可。
cautionsEn: Moxa boundary: eLotus and AD only state moxibustion only and supply no direct/indirect method, cone count, skin protection, thermal-injury stopping rule, or pediatric protocol; the legacy 7-15-cone dose is not promoted to an executable instruction.

Needling/bloodletting conflict: legacy 0.3-0.5-cun needling and prick-to-bleed differ from both exact pages and lack exact-page support; they are neither executed nor merged. The legacy finger-sanitation note is technique-ambiguous and cannot substitute for a bloodletting safety protocol.
Emergency boundary: the legacy term intestinal abscess is not treated as evidence for appendicitis efficacy; NIDDK identifies suspected appendicitis as a medical emergency requiring immediate care.

Special-population gap: the four layers provide no point-specific protocol for pregnancy, children, sensory impairment, fragile skin, anticoagulation, or coagulopathy; source silence is not clearance.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 American Dragon 精確頁都支持鷹嘴尖定位、瘰癧與『只灸』；eLotus 另列化痰消腫，AD 另列化膿性癰腫與淋巴結炎，但 AD 的 Command Functions／Actions 欄空白。舊腸癰不收入療效標籤，只保留在 NIDDK 支持的急症邊界。
clinical_pearls_en: The exact eLotus and American Dragon pages both support the olecranon-tip location, scrofula, and moxibustion only. eLotus additionally lists phlegm transformation and swelling dissipation; AD additionally lists abscessed carbuncle and lymphadenitis, while its Command Functions and Actions fields are blank. Legacy intestinal abscess is excluded from efficacy tags and retained only at the NIDDK-supported emergency boundary.
nameIntroZh: 『肘尖』即肘後最突出的尺骨鷹嘴尖；英文主名採 eLotus 的 Elbow Tip，AD 作 Elbow's Tip。
nameIntroEn: Zhoujian means the pointed tip of the elbow, the prominent ulnar olecranon; the primary English name follows eLotus's Elbow Tip, while AD uses Elbow's Tip.
evidence:
四層整合：肘尖不在 NCBAHM Appendix A 明列清單，本地 curriculum/acupoints 無專條。eLotus 精確頁支持 Ex-UE1、鷹嘴尖定位、瘰癧、化痰消腫與只灸。AD 拼音索引及 Zhoujian 精確頁支持 M-UE-46、同一定位、只灸、瘰癧、化膿性癰腫與淋巴結炎；其功效欄空白。舊散結解毒、腸癰、直接灸7～15壯、直刺0.3～0.5寸、放血與手指消毒警語均保留證據層級；NIDDK 僅支持闌尾炎急症邊界，不支持本穴療效。
Four-layer synthesis: Zhoujian is not explicitly named in NCBAHM Appendix A, and no dedicated curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus page supports Ex-UE1, the olecranon-tip location, scrofula, phlegm transformation, swelling dissipation, and moxibustion only. The AD pinyin index and exact Zhoujian page support M-UE-46, the same location, moxibustion only, scrofula, abscessed carbuncle, and lymphadenitis; its action fields are blank. Legacy nodule/toxicity actions, intestinal abscess, 7-15 direct cones, 0.3-0.5-cun needling, bloodletting, and finger-sanitation wording retain their evidence level; NIDDK supports only the appendicitis emergency boundary, not point efficacy.

needling: eLotus／American Dragon：只灸。舊直刺0.3～0.5寸或點刺出血無精確頁支持，僅作 legacy 記錄。
needlingEn: eLotus/American Dragon: moxibustion only. Legacy 0.3-0.5-cun needling or prick-to-bleed lacks exact-page support and is retained only as legacy.

location: 前臂掌側，腕橫紋上4寸，橈側腕屈肌腱兩側各一穴，一側前臂共2穴。eLotus 與 American Dragon 均支持此核心定位；AD 另列以 PC7 或掌側腕橫紋為起點的文字變體。
locationEn: On the flexor aspect of the forearm, 4 cun proximal to the wrist crease, with one point on each side of the flexor carpi radialis tendon (two points per forearm). eLotus and American Dragon support this core location; AD also records wording variants measured from PC7 or the middle palmar wrist crease.
cunMeasurement: 腕橫紋上4寸；每側前臂以橈側腕屈肌腱為中心取兩穴。 4 cun proximal to the wrist crease, one point on each side of the flexor carpi radialis tendon on each forearm.
anatomyZh: 精確頁僅共同指定前臂屈側與橈側腕屈肌腱兩側，未提供皮下層次、血管神經走行、個體體型修正或安全終點。故不可由『肌腱兩側』自行推導更深刺法。
anatomyEn: The exact pages identify only the flexor forearm and the two sides of the flexor carpi radialis tendon; they do not supply tissue layers, neurovascular course, body-habitus adjustment, or a safety endpoint. A deeper technique must not be inferred from the phrase 'on both sides of the tendon.'
acumethodZh: eLotus：直刺0.5～1.0寸。American Dragon 同時列直刺0.5～1.0寸與垂直刺0.5～1.5寸兩個版本；各來源範圍分開保留，不合併成單一共識。舊卡另有直刺0.3～0.5寸或點刺出血，未獲四層精確來源支持，僅保留為未核實 legacy。
acumethodEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.5-1.0 cun. American Dragon records both straight insertion 0.5-1.0 cun and perpendicular insertion 0.5-1.5 cun as separate variants; the source ranges remain separate rather than being merged into false consensus. Legacy 0.3-0.5-cun insertion or prick-to-bleed lacks support from the four exact layers and is retained only as unverified legacy.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 均寫可灸，但未列直接／間接法、壯數、時間、皮膚保護或停止規則；不可自行補數字。
moxaEn: Both eLotus and American Dragon state that moxibustion is applicable, but neither gives a direct/indirect method, cone count, duration, skin protection, or stopping rule; no numeric dose is inferred.
techniqueNotes:
【eLotus】直刺0.5～1.0寸；可灸。
【American Dragon】直刺0.5～1.0寸；另列垂直刺0.5～1.5寸；可灸。
【未核實舊值】直刺0.3～0.5寸或點刺出血，不作已驗證規則。
eLotus: perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun; moxibustion applicable. American Dragon: straight 0.5-1.0 cun and a separate perpendicular 0.5-1.5-cun variant; moxibustion applicable. Unverified legacy: 0.3-0.5 cun or prick to bleed, not treated as a validated rule.
functions: 益直腸（eLotus）；調和氣血、升提下陷、清腸止血（舊卡）

exam_importance: NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Erbai。考點為腕橫紋上4寸、橈側腕屈肌腱兩側各一穴，以及 eLotus／AD 共同支持痔瘡與脫肛；刺深須分開記 eLotus 0.5～1.0寸與 AD 的兩個版本。
exam_importance_en: Erbai is explicitly named in NCBAHM Appendix A. Know the location 4 cun proximal to the wrist crease on both sides of the flexor carpi radialis tendon, the shared eLotus/AD indications of hemorrhoids and rectal prolapse, and the source-separated needling ranges.
exam_pearl: 二白＝每側前臂2穴：腕橫紋上4寸、橈側腕屈肌腱兩側。Board 明列；刺深不可把 eLotus 0.5～1.0寸與 AD 0.5～1.5寸硬合併。
exam_pearl_en: Erbai consists of two points on each forearm, 4 cun above the wrist crease on both sides of the flexor carpi radialis tendon. It is Board-listed; do not merge the eLotus 0.5-1.0-cun range with AD's 0.5-1.5-cun variant.
patterns: 便血（American Dragon；診斷／急症邊界）
patternsEn: Blood in stool (American Dragon; diagnostic/emergency boundary)
action_tags_en: Clear the Intestines and Stop Bleeding
combinePointsZh: 【American Dragon：慢性痔瘡】二白配承山（BL57）、長強（GV1）。【American Dragon：脫肛／痔瘡】二白配百會（GV20）、志室（BL52）、長強（GV1）。兩組依 AD 表格欄位逐欄核對；舊卡僅有前一組，未另立功效推論。
combinePointsEn: American Dragon—chronic hemorrhoids: Erbai with BL57 (Chengshan) and GV1 (Changqiang). American Dragon—rectal prolapse/hemorrhoids: Erbai with GV20 (Baihui), BL52 (Zhishi), and GV1 (Changqiang). Both groups were checked column by column in the AD table; the legacy card contained only the first group, and no new combination action is inferred.
cautions: 【刺深分歧】eLotus 為0.5～1.0寸；AD 同頁另列0.5～1.0寸與0.5～1.5寸，不合併成假共識。精確頁未提供個體體型修正、深層解剖或安全終點。【放血缺口】舊點刺出血無精確頁支持，且四層未提供無菌、止血、抗凝／凝血異常或感染控制規則，不執行。【便血邊界】AD 將便血列為主治，但便血不是可自行歸因於痔瘡的療效標籤；NIDDK 指出急性或嚴重消化道出血、黑便、暈厥／頭暈或休克徵象需立即就醫。【特殊族群缺口】四層未提供孕期、兒童或特殊風險族群的專穴方案；來源沉默不是安全許可。舊『避免過深傷及骨膜』缺精確來源與解剖對應，保留為 unsupported legacy，不升格。
cautionsEn: Depth conflict: eLotus gives 0.5-1.0 cun; AD separately records 0.5-1.0 cun and 0.5-1.5 cun on the same page. These are not merged into false consensus, and the exact pages provide no body-habitus adjustment, deep-anatomy description, or safety endpoint.

Bloodletting gap: legacy prick-to-bleed lacks exact-page support, and the four layers provide no sterility, hemostasis, anticoagulation/coagulopathy, or infection-control protocol; it is not executed.

Blood-in-stool boundary: AD lists blood in stool as an indication, but this is not treated as an efficacy tag that may be self-attributed to hemorrhoids. NIDDK advises immediate medical help for acute or severe GI bleeding, black/tarry stool, faintness/dizziness, or shock signs.

Special-population gap: the four layers provide no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or other high-risk protocol; source silence is not clearance. The legacy warning about overly deep insertion reaching periosteum lacks an exact source and anatomical correlation and remains unsupported legacy.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD 對核心定位、痔瘡、脫肛與可灸一致；eLotus 明列『益直腸』，AD 的 Command Functions 欄空白但 Actions 寫治脫肛與痔瘡，並增加肛門搔癢、便血、裏急後重及前臂神經痛。刺深存在同頁版本差異，必須逐來源顯示。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus and AD agree on the core location, hemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, and moxibustion applicability. eLotus explicitly states that the point benefits the rectum. AD's Command Functions field is blank, while its Actions field states treatment of rectal prolapse and hemorrhoids and its indications add anal itching, blood in stool, tenesmus, and forearm neuralgia. Needling depth varies by source/version and must remain source-separated.
nameIntroZh: 『二白』為成對取穴：每側前臂在橈側腕屈肌腱兩側各一穴；英文標準顯示名採 Two Whites。
nameIntroEn: Erbai, 'Two Whites,' is a paired arrangement on each forearm, with one point on either side of the flexor carpi radialis tendon.
evidence:
四層整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Erbai；本地 curriculum/acupoints 無二白專條，僅在其他穴位配穴文字中提及。eLotus 精確頁支持 Ex-UE2、腕橫紋上4寸與橈側腕屈肌腱兩側的定位、痔瘡、脫肛、益直腸、直刺0.5～1.0寸及可灸。American Dragon 拼音索引及精確頁支持 M-UE-29、三個定位文字版本、0.5～1.0與0.5～1.5寸兩種刺法、可灸、痔瘡、脫肛、肛癢、便血、裏急後重、前臂神經痛及兩組配穴；其 Command Functions 欄空白。舊調和氣血／升提／清腸止血、0.3～0.5寸、點刺出血與骨膜警語保留證據層級。NIDDK 僅支持便血的醫療評估／急症邊界，不支持穴位療效。
Four-layer synthesis: NCBAHM Appendix A explicitly names Erbai. No dedicated local curriculum entry was found; it appears only in combination text for other points. The exact eLotus page supports Ex-UE2, the 4-cun/FCR-tendon location, hemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, benefit to the rectum, 0.5-1.0-cun perpendicular needling, and moxibustion. The AD pinyin index and exact page support M-UE-29, three location wordings, separate 0.5-1.0- and 0.5-1.5-cun techniques, moxibustion, hemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, anal itching, blood in stool, tenesmus, forearm neuralgia, and two combination groups; its Command Functions field is blank. Legacy Qi/blood and prolapse/bleeding actions, 0.3-0.5-cun depth, prick-to-bleed, and periosteum warning retain their evidence level. NIDDK supports only the medical-assessment/emergency boundary for GI bleeding, not point efficacy.

location: 腕背橫紋上，陽溪（LI5）與陽池（TE4）之間的凹陷中。eLotus 精確頁支持此定位；Board 與本地課件無專條，AD 索引的近似拼音項目錯鏈至另一穴，不能作定位佐證。
locationEn: On the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression between LI5 (Yangxi) and TE4 (Yangchi). cautions: 【腕背刺法】唯一可用精確穴位頁為 eLotus 直刺0.3～0.5寸；該頁未提供肌腱／關節囊／血管神經層次、體型修正或安全終點，不能自行加深。【放血缺口】舊點刺出血與『關節部位注意消毒』未獲精確頁支持，且缺無菌、止血、抗凝／凝血異常與感染控制規程；保留為 unsupported legacy，不執行。【胸痛／心絞痛】AHA 指出胸部壓迫、擠壓、飽脹或疼痛，尤其伴呼吸短促、冷汗、噁心或頭暈，應立即呼叫急救；穴位主治不取代急性冠脈評估。【氣喘】NHLBI 指出嚴重發作或緩解藥後仍呼吸困難需急診／急救。【咯血】NHS 指出即使少量血痰也需儘快評估；量多或合併呼吸困難、心搏很快、胸／上背痛需立即急診。【特殊族群缺口】四層未提供孕期、兒童或其他高風險專穴方案；來源沉默不是安全許可。
cautionsEn: Dorsal-wrist technique: the only usable exact point page is eLotus at 0.3-0.5 cun perpendicular. It provides no tendon, joint-capsule, neurovascular, body-habitus, or safety-endpoint detail, so a deeper method is not inferred.

Bloodletting gap: legacy prick-to-bleed and the generic joint-sterility warning lack exact-page support and provide no sterility, hemostasis, anticoagulation/coagulopathy, or infection-control protocol. They remain unsupported legacy and are not executed.

Chest pain/angina: AHA advises emergency activation for heart-attack warning signs such as pressure, squeezing, fullness, or pain in the chest, especially with shortness of breath, cold sweat, nausea, or lightheadedness. A point indication does not replace acute coronary evaluation.
Asthma: NHLBI advises emergency evaluation when an attack is serious or breathing remains very hard despite reliever medicine.

Hemoptysis: NHS advises prompt assessment even for small flecks of blood and immediate emergency care for more than a few spots or when accompanied by breathing difficulty, a very fast heartbeat, or chest/upper-back pain.
Special-population gap: the four layers provide no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or other high-risk protocol; source silence is not clearance.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 是本輪唯一可用的中泉內容專頁，完整支持定位、四項功效、七項主治、0.3～0.5寸與可灸。American Dragon 索引列 Zhongchuan 而非 Zhongquan，且點擊後進入空白的 Ganrexue N-BW-8 頁；此站內錯鏈明列為 source gap，不猜另一個 URL。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus is the only usable Zhongquan content page in this audit and supports the location, four actions, seven indications, 0.3-0.5-cun technique, and moxibustion. American Dragon indexes Zhongchuan rather than Zhongquan, and clicking it opens the blank Ganrexue N-BW-8 page. This site-level mislink is documented as a source gap rather than repaired with a guessed URL.
nameIntroZh: 『中泉』英文意譯 Middle Spring；本庫穩定拼音採 Zhongquan。AD 索引的 Zhongchuan 僅作錯鏈稽核紀錄，不改本庫名稱或代碼。
nameIntroEn: Zhongquan means 'Middle Spring.' The database retains the stable pinyin Zhongquan; AD's indexed Zhongchuan is documented only as a mislink audit and does not change the database name or code.
evidence:
四層整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 未明列 Zhongquan，本地 curriculum/board 與 curriculum/acupoints 搜尋無專條。eLotus 精確頁支持 Ex-UE3／Middle Spring、LI5 與 TE4 之間定位、寬胸理氣、和胃止痛、胸脅脹痛、咳嗽、氣喘、心絞痛、胃痛、咯血、掌心熱、直刺0.3～0.5寸與可灸。American Dragon 索引無 Zhongquan；其 Zhongchuan 項實際連到空白 Ganrexue N-BW-8 頁，故記為 AD exact-page gap，不吸收內容也不猜 URL。舊嘔吐、腕痛、點刺出血與關節消毒警語保留證據層級。AHA、NHLBI、NHS 只支持胸痛、嚴重氣喘與咯血的急症邊界，不支持穴位療效。
Four-layer synthesis: NCBAHM Appendix A does not explicitly name Zhongquan, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus page supports Ex-UE3/Middle Spring, the LI5-to-TE4 location, chest/Qi and Stomach/pain actions, seven indications, 0.3-0.5-cun perpendicular needling, and moxibustion. American Dragon has no Zhongquan index item; its Zhongchuan item opens a blank Ganrexue N-BW-8 page, so AD remains an exact-page gap and no content or guessed URL is used. Legacy vomiting, wrist pain, bloodletting, and joint-sterility wording retain their evidence level. AHA, NHLBI, and NHS support only emergency boundaries for chest pain, severe asthma, and hemoptysis, not point efficacy.

needling: American Dragon：直刺0.2～0.3寸。eLotus 未列針刺。舊0.3～0.5寸、透刺或點刺出血未核實。
needlingEn: American Dragon: perpendicular insertion 0.2-0.3 cun. eLotus lists no needling. Legacy 0.3-0.5-cun, penetrating, or prick-to-bleed methods are unverified.

location: 拇指背側，指間關節橫紋中央。American Dragon 支持此表述；eLotus 寫成『distal 與 middle phalanges 間』，但拇指通常只有近節與遠節指骨，故保留其原文異常而以單一拇指指間關節作表面定位，不自行創造另一關節。
locationEn: On the dorsal thumb, at the center of the interphalangeal joint crease. American Dragon supports this wording. eLotus describes the crease between the distal and middle phalanges, although the thumb normally has proximal and distal phalanges only; the source anomaly is retained while the single thumb interphalangeal joint remains the surface landmark.
cunMeasurement: 本穴以拇指指間關節背側橫紋中央定位，不使用寸量。 Located by the center of the dorsal thumb interphalangeal crease rather than a cun measurement.
anatomyZh: 精確頁只提供拇指指間關節背側表面標誌，未描述伸肌腱、關節囊、側副韌帶、指背血管神經、皮膚至關節深度或體型修正。eLotus 的 distal／middle phalanx 用語具解剖命名異常，不可據此推導額外關節或更深刺法。
anatomyEn: The exact pages provide only the dorsal thumb interphalangeal surface landmark and do not describe the extensor tendon, joint capsule, collateral ligaments, dorsal digital neurovascular structures, skin-to-joint depth, or body-habitus adjustment. eLotus's distal/middle-phalanx wording is anatomically anomalous and cannot support an additional joint or deeper technique.
acumethodZh: eLotus：直刺0.1寸。American Dragon 只寫使用灸法，未給針刺深度，但未明文寫『禁針』。舊卡直刺0.5～0.8寸遠深於 eLotus，缺精確頁支持，不合併、不執行，僅保留為 unsupported legacy。
acumethodEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.1 cun. American Dragon lists moxibustion and gives no needling depth, but does not explicitly state that needling is forbidden. Legacy 0.5-0.8-cun insertion is much deeper than eLotus and lacks exact-page support; it is neither merged nor executed and remains unsupported legacy.
moxaZh: eLotus 寫可灸；American Dragon 寫使用灸法。兩頁均未給直接／間接法、壯數、時間、皮膚保護或停止規則。舊卡灸5～7壯無具名精確來源，不升格為劑量共識。
moxaEn: eLotus states that moxibustion is applicable, and American Dragon instructs use of moxibustion. Neither page gives a direct/indirect method, cone count, duration, skin protection, or stopping rule. The legacy 5-7-cone dose has no named exact source and is not promoted to consensus.
techniqueNotes:
【eLotus】直刺0.1寸；可灸，灸量未提供。
【American Dragon】使用灸法；未列針刺、灸量或方法。
【未核實舊值】直刺0.5～0.8寸、灸5～7壯；不作已驗證規則。
eLotus: perpendicular 0.1 cun; moxibustion applicable without dose. American Dragon: use moxibustion, with no needling or moxa dose/method. Unverified legacy: 0.5-0.8-cun insertion and 5-7 cones; not treated as validated rules.
functions: 益目、降逆（eLotus）；清熱明目、消腫止痛（舊卡）
functionsEn: Benefits the eyes and calms rebellious Qi (eLotus); clears Heat, brightens the eyes, reduces swelling, and relieves pain (legacy)

exam_importance: NCBAHM Appendix A 未明列 Dagukong，本地課件無專條。複習拇指指間關節背側橫紋中央、eLotus 直刺0.1寸、兩源均支持灸法，以及 eLotus distal／middle phalanges 用語異常與舊0.5～0.8寸不可合併。
exam_importance_en: Dagukong is not explicitly named in NCBAHM Appendix A and has no dedicated local curriculum entry. Review the center of the dorsal thumb interphalangeal crease, eLotus's 0.1-cun insertion, shared moxa support, the anomalous eLotus distal/middle-phalanx wording, and why legacy 0.5-0.8 cun cannot be merged.
exam_pearl: 大骨空＝拇指 IP 背側橫紋中央。eLotus 直刺僅0.1寸；AD 為 M-UE-15，只列灸法。
exam_pearl_en: Dagukong lies at the center of the dorsal thumb IP crease. eLotus gives only 0.1 cun; AD M-UE-15 lists moxibustion without a needling depth.
patterns: 白翳／角膜混濁類表述（舊卡）
combinePointsZh: eLotus、American Dragon 精確頁及舊卡均未列大骨空專屬配穴；不把其他眼病、嘔吐或腹瀉穴位的組方移植到本穴。
combinePointsEn: The exact eLotus and American Dragon pages and the legacy card provide no Dagukong-specific combination. Combinations for eye disorders, vomiting, or diarrhea involving other points are not transferred to this point.
cautions: 【定位用語】eLotus 的 distal／middle phalanges 描述不符合拇指通常只有近節與遠節指骨的命名；卡片保留原文異常並以兩源共同指向的拇指單一 IP 橫紋定位，不推導第二關節。【刺深衝突】eLotus 直刺0.1寸，舊卡0.5～0.8寸缺精確頁支持且明顯更深；不合併、不執行舊值。精確頁未給關節囊、伸肌腱、指背血管神經、體型修正或停止規則。【灸法】兩源未給灸量、皮膚保護或熱傷害停止規則；舊5～7壯不升格。【legacy 解剖警語】舊『避開橈動脈』與拇指 IP 背側定位缺精確頁解剖對應，保留為 unsupported legacy。【特殊族群缺口】無孕期、兒童、感覺障礙、皮膚脆弱或凝血風險的專穴方案。
cautionsEn: Location wording: eLotus's distal/middle-phalanges description does not match the usual thumb anatomy of proximal and distal phalanges. The anomaly is retained, while the single thumb IP crease jointly indicated by the sources is used without inferring a second joint.

Depth conflict: eLotus gives 0.1 cun; legacy 0.5-0.8 cun is much deeper and lacks exact-page support. It is not merged or executed. The exact pages provide no capsule, extensor-tendon, dorsal digital neurovascular, body-habitus, or stopping-rule detail.
Moxa boundary: neither source supplies dose, skin protection, or a thermal-injury stopping rule; legacy 5-7 cones is not promoted.
Legacy anatomy warning: 'avoid the radial artery' lacks an exact-page anatomical correlation with the dorsal thumb IP location and remains unsupported legacy.
Special-population gap: no point-specific protocol was found for pregnancy, children, sensory impairment, fragile skin, or coagulation risk.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD 對拇指背側指間關節橫紋及眼病、嘔吐、腹瀉一致；只有 eLotus 給0.1寸直刺，AD 只列灸法。舊卡把白翳譯為 pterygium 過窄，改以白翳／角膜混濁類表述保留。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus and AD agree on the dorsal thumb interphalangeal crease and eye disorders, vomiting, and diarrhea. Only eLotus gives 0.1-cun insertion; AD lists moxibustion without a needling depth. The legacy translation of Baiyi as pterygium was too narrow and is retained as Baiyi/corneal-opacity-type wording.
nameIntroZh: 『大骨空』英文主名採 eLotus 的 Greater Bone Hollow；AD 作 Big Bone's Space。
nameIntroEn: Dagukong is rendered primarily as Greater Bone Hollow by eLotus; AD uses Big Bone's Space.
evidence:
四層整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 未明列 Dagukong，本地 curriculum 無專條。eLotus 精確頁支持 Ex-UE5、Greater Bone Hollow、拇指背側關節橫紋、眼病／嘔吐／腹瀉、益目降逆、直刺0.1寸與可灸，但其 distal／middle phalanges 用語具解剖命名異常。AD 索引及精確頁支持 M-UE-15、Big Bone's Space、拇指指骨關節背側橫紋、同三項主治與灸法；Actions／Combinations／Contraindications 皆空白。舊清熱消腫止痛、特定眼症、鼻衄、0.5～0.8寸、5～7壯與橈動脈警語保留證據層級；無 generic CloudTCM。
Four-layer synthesis: NCBAHM Appendix A does not explicitly name Dagukong, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus page supports Ex-UE5, Greater Bone Hollow, the dorsal thumb joint crease, eye disorders/vomiting/diarrhea, eye and rebellious-Qi actions, 0.1-cun insertion, and moxibustion, while its distal/middle-phalanx wording is anatomically anomalous. The AD index and exact page support M-UE-15, Big Bone's Space, the dorsal thumb phalangeal-joint crease, the same three indications, and moxibustion; Actions, Combinations, and Contraindications are blank. Legacy Heat/swelling/pain actions, specific eye findings, epistaxis, 0.5-0.8 cun, 5-7 cones, and radial-artery warning retain their evidence level. No generic CloudTCM source is used.

location: Canonical 定位（Ting 2026-08-08 裁決）：手背，小指近端指間關節（PIP）背側橫紋中央。eLotus Ex-UE6 另定位於遠端指間關節（DIP；遠節與中節指骨間）中央，列為 alternate location／source conflict，不與 PIP 合併成假共識。
locationEn: Canonical location (Ting adjudication, 2026-08-08): on the dorsal little finger, at the midpoint of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint crease. eLotus Ex-UE6 instead places the point at the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint, between the distal and middle phalanges; this is retained as an alternate location/source conflict and is not merged into a false consensus.
cunMeasurement: 以小指 PIP 背側橫紋中央為 canonical 關節標誌，不使用骨度分寸；eLotus alternate 為 DIP 中央。
anatomyZh: Canonical PIP 標誌位於小指近端指間關節背側，表層為皮膚與皮下組織，深部鄰近伸肌裝置及關節囊。四層來源未提供皮膚至關節深度、指背神經血管走向、伸肌腱或關節囊安全終點；且 eLotus 的 DIP alternate 代表另一解剖層面，操作前不得混用定位。
anatomyEn: The canonical PIP landmark is on the dorsal proximal interphalangeal joint of the little finger, with skin and subcutaneous tissue superficial to the extensor apparatus and joint capsule. The four-source set does not provide skin-to-joint depth, dorsal digital neurovascular course, or extensor-tendon/joint-capsule safety endpoints. The eLotus DIP alternate represents a different anatomical level and must not be interchanged with the PIP location.
acumethodZh: Canonical 技法：不針刺、不點刺放血；只灸。eLotus exact page 明列 moxibustion only。舊卡直刺0.3～0.5寸與點刺出血均為 unsupported legacy，保留於證據層但不進可執行技法。
acumethodEn: Canonical technique: no needling and no prick-to-bleed; moxibustion only. The exact eLotus page explicitly states moxibustion only. Legacy perpendicular insertion 0.3-0.5 cun and prick-to-bleed are retained as unsupported history but excluded from executable technique.
moxaZh: 只灸。eLotus 未給壯數、時間、距離或直接／間接灸法。舊卡灸5～7壯保留為未核實 legacy 值，不作 canonical 劑量；皮膚保護與停止條件仍為 source gap。
moxaEn: Moxibustion only. eLotus gives no cone count, duration, distance, or direct/indirect method. The legacy 5-7-cone value is retained as unverified history and is not a canonical dose; skin-protection and stopping criteria remain source gaps.
techniqueNotes:
Canonical：PIP 定位，只灸；無已核實灸量。eLotus：DIP alternate，只灸。Legacy：直刺0.3～0.5寸、點刺出血及灸5～7壯均 unsupported／不可執行。
Canonical: PIP location and moxibustion only, with no verified dose. eLotus: DIP alternate and moxibustion only. Legacy needling, bloodletting, and 5-7 cones are unsupported/non-executable.
functions: 益目，止痛；清熱明目、消腫止痛（legacy）
functionsEn: Benefits the eyes and alleviates pain; clears heat/brightens the eyes and reduces swelling/alleviates pain (legacy)
functionsEnList: Clears heat and brightens the eyes (legacy)
pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE6／ex.ue6，小骨空 Xiaogukong。Canonical 定位依 Ting 2026-08-08 裁決採 PIP；eLotus Ex-UE6 的 DIP 定位保留為 source_conflict／alternate location。American Dragon 拼音索引無 Xiaogukong；索引中的 Gukong 不作本穴證據。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE6 / ex.ue6, Xiaogukong. Per Ting's 2026-08-08 adjudication, the canonical location is PIP; the eLotus Ex-UE6 DIP location is retained as a source conflict/alternate location. The American Dragon pinyin index has no Xiaogukong entry, and its Gukong entry is not used as evidence for this point.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 未明列 Xiaogukong。考點是辨識 PIP canonical 與 eLotus DIP alternate 的 documented conflict，並記住本卡 canonical 技法為只灸。
exam_importance_en: Xiaogukong is not explicitly listed in the NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A. The key study issue is the documented PIP-canonical versus eLotus-DIP alternate-location conflict and the card's moxibustion-only canonical technique.
exam_pearl: 定位先問『PIP 還是 DIP』：本庫採 PIP，eLotus DIP 不刪但必須標衝突。技法只灸；舊針刺與放血不能當作已核實規則。
exam_pearl_en: First ask whether the source uses PIP or DIP: this database uses PIP, while the eLotus DIP location remains visible as a conflict. Technique is moxibustion only; legacy needling and bloodletting are not verified rules.
patterns: 白翳（legacy；不窄化為翼狀胬肉）
combinePointsZh: 四層來源與 legacy 卡均未提供小骨空 point-specific 配穴；不借用大骨空、Gukong 或其他眼疾穴位配伍。
combinePointsEn: The four-source set and legacy card provide no Xiaogukong-specific combination; combinations from Dagukong, Gukong, or other eye points are not borrowed.
cautions: 【定位衝突】Canonical 採 PIP；eLotus 為 DIP alternate，兩者不可混用。【技法邊界】只灸；舊直刺0.3～0.5寸與點刺出血 unsupported，不執行。【局部安全缺口】來源未給伸肌裝置、關節囊、指背神經血管或皮膚至關節的安全終點。【灸法缺口】無壯數、時間、距離、直接／間接法、皮膚保護或停止規則；舊5～7壯不升格。【特殊族群】孕期、兒童、感覺障礙、皮膚脆弱及循環不良者均無 point-specific protocol，source silence 不等於安全。
cautionsEn: [Location conflict] Canonical location is PIP; eLotus gives a DIP alternate, and the two must not be interchanged. [Technique boundary] Moxibustion only; legacy 0.3-0.5-cun needling and prick-to-bleed are unsupported and non-executable. [Local safety gap] Sources provide no endpoint for the extensor apparatus, joint capsule, dorsal digital nerves/vessels, or skin-to-joint depth. [Moxa gap] No cone count, duration, distance, direct/indirect method, skin protection, or stopping rule is supplied; legacy 5-7 cones are not promoted. [Special populations] There is no point-specific protocol for pregnancy, children, sensory loss, fragile skin, or impaired circulation; source silence is not proof of safety.
clinical_pearls: 本卡最重要的不是把 PIP 與 DIP 平均化，而是讓操作者先辨認所採標準；canonical PIP 與 eLotus DIP alternate 必須同時可見。
eLotus 支持眼疾、耳聾、手指關節痛與只灸；舊白翳、咽喉腫痛、清熱消腫與數字技法保留但證據層級較低。
clinical_pearls_en: The key is not to average PIP and DIP, but to identify the selected standard before treatment; canonical PIP and the eLotus DIP alternate must both remain visible.
eLotus supports eye disorders, deafness, hand-joint pain, and moxibustion only; legacy Baiyi, throat swelling, heat/swelling actions, and numeric techniques remain at a lower evidence level.
nameIntroZh: 小骨空（Xiǎogǔkōng，Lesser Bone Hollow）為小指背側經外奇穴。本庫保留 EX-UE6／ex.ue6，並明列 PIP canonical 與 eLotus DIP alternate 的定位衝突。
nameIntroEn: Xiaogukong (Lesser Bone Hollow) is an extra point on the dorsal little finger. The database preserves EX-UE6 / ex.ue6 and explicitly records the conflict between the canonical PIP and eLotus DIP alternate locations.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A does not explicitly list Xiaogukong, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. Ting's 2026-08-08 adjudication selects the PIP midpoint as the canonical location based on multiple traditional/standardized sources while requiring the eLotus DIP location to remain as a documented alternate/source conflict. The exact eLotus Ex-UE6 page contributes the DIP location, eye disorders, deafness, hand-joint pain, eye/pain applications, and moxibustion-only technique. American Dragon's pinyin index has no Xiaogukong entry; per Ting, Gukong is not treated as Xiaogukong evidence. Legacy PIP needling, bloodletting, 5-7-cone moxa, throat/Baiyi indications, and heat/swelling functions are preserved with unsupported labels rather than promoted.

needling: 不針刺、不點刺出血；canonical 只灸。舊直刺0.3～0.5寸與點刺出血為 unsupported legacy，不執行。
needlingEn: No needling and no prick-to-bleed; canonical technique is moxibustion only. Legacy 0.3-0.5-cun needling and prick-to-bleed are unsupported and non-executable.

location: 手背，腕背橫紋與掌指關節的中點：一穴在第2、3掌骨間，另一穴在第4、5掌骨間；雙手共4穴。舊卡的『腕背橫紋遠端1寸』及 American Dragon Yaotong 1／3 的掌骨基底關節定位列為來源變體，不與 eLotus 中點定位合併。
locationEn: On the dorsum of the hand, midway between the dorsal wrist crease and the metacarpophalangeal joints: one point between the second and third metacarpals and another between the fourth and fifth, for four points bilaterally. The legacy '1 cun distal to the wrist crease' and American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 metacarpal-base articulations are retained as source variants rather than merged with the eLotus midpoint location.
cunMeasurement: 以腕背橫紋至掌指關節的中點及相應掌骨間隙定位；舊1寸說與 American Dragon 掌骨基底關節說為 alternate locations。
anatomyZh: 定位在手背兩個掌骨間區域。來源未提供各變體定位的皮膚至骨間肌深度、伸肌腱與手背靜脈／神經血管的個別走向，也未提供可安全承受腰部動作的留針終點；不同定位與方向不可互換。
anatomyEn: The points occupy two dorsal intermetacarpal regions. The sources do not provide location-specific skin-to-interosseous depth, extensor-tendon or dorsal venous/neurovascular trajectories, or an endpoint for retained needles during lumbar movement; location and direction variants must not be interchanged.
acumethodZh: eLotus：直刺0.5～1.0寸。American Dragon Yaotong 1與3為相關變體，均記向腕部斜刺1～1.5寸，但其掌骨基底定位不等同本卡 eLotus 中點定位。舊卡向腕部斜刺0.5～0.8寸及留針配合腰部活動保留為 legacy；舊點刺出血無精確來源與操作規格，不進 canonical technique。
acumethodEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.5-1.0 cun. American Dragon Yaotong 1 and 3 are related variants using wristward slanted insertion 1-1.5 cun at metacarpal-base locations that are not identical to this card's eLotus midpoint location. Legacy wristward oblique insertion 0.5-0.8 cun and retained-needle lumbar movement remain historical. Legacy prick-to-bleed lacks an exact source and procedural parameters and is excluded from canonical technique.
moxaZh: 四層來源與舊卡均未提供腰痛點 point-specific 灸法劑量或技法；不自行補壯數、時間或禁忌。
moxaEn: The four-source set and legacy card provide no point-specific moxibustion dose or method for Yaotongxue; no cone count, duration, or contraindication is inferred.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus 中點定位：直刺0.5～1.0寸。American Dragon Yaotong 1／3 變體：掌骨基底定位，向腕部斜刺1～1.5寸。Legacy：向腕部斜刺0.5～0.8寸並配合腰部活動；點刺出血 unsupported。
eLotus midpoint location: perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun. American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 variants: wristward slanted insertion 1-1.5 cun at metacarpal-base locations. Legacy: wristward oblique 0.5-0.8 cun with lumbar movement; prick-to-bleed unsupported.
functions: 利腰；活血止痛、疏經通絡、舒筋利腰（legacy）
functionsEn: Benefits the lower back; activates blood and alleviates pain, unblocks the channels/collaterals, and relaxes the sinews to benefit the lower back (legacy)
functionsEnList: Relaxes the sinews and benefits the lower back (legacy)
pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE7／ex.ue7，腰痛點 Yaotongxue。NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Yaotongxue。eLotus 為 Ex-UE7；American Dragon 無 Yaotongxue exact entry，僅有 Yaotong 1、2、3，其中1與3分別接近本卡兩個掌骨間區，2位於第3、4掌骨間而不納入本穴證據。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE7 / ex.ue7, Yaotongxue. NCBAHM Appendix A lists Yaotongxue and eLotus codes it Ex-UE7. American Dragon has no exact Yaotongxue entry; its Yaotong 1 and 3 approximate the card's two intermetacarpal regions, while Yaotong 2 lies between the third and fourth metacarpals and is excluded as evidence for this point.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列腰痛點。需分辨 eLotus 的腕橫紋至掌指關節中點、舊卡1寸說，以及 American Dragon Yaotong 1／3 的掌骨基底變體；刺法數字只能跟隨各自定位。
exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Yaotongxue. Distinguish the eLotus wrist-crease-to-MCP midpoint from the legacy 1-cun description and American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 metacarpal-base variants; technique numbers must remain attached to their source locations.
exam_pearl: 兩側手各兩穴；先確認採哪一套定位，再讀其刺向與深度，不能把中點定位和掌骨基底的1～1.5寸斜刺拼成假共識。
exam_pearl_en: There are two points on each hand. Identify the location standard before applying direction and depth; do not combine the midpoint location with 1-1.5-cun slanted insertion from metacarpal-base variants.
combinePointsZh: 舊卡記【急性腰扭傷】腰痛點配委中（BL40）、人中（GV26）並配合腰部活動；四層來源未核實此配穴與動態操作，保留為 unsupported legacy，不作已驗證方案。
combinePointsEn: The legacy card pairs Yaotongxue with Weizhong (BL40) and Shuigou (GV26) for acute lumbar sprain and adds lumbar movement. The four-source set does not verify this combination or dynamic procedure; it is retained as unsupported legacy rather than a verified protocol.
cautions: 【來源衝突】eLotus 中點定位直刺0.5～1.0寸；American Dragon Yaotong 1／3 掌骨基底變體向腕部斜刺1～1.5寸；舊0.5～0.8寸向腕斜刺另列，數字不可跨定位套用。【局部安全缺口】各來源未給伸肌腱、手背靜脈／神經血管及骨間結構的安全終點。【動態針法缺口】留針活動腰部的幅度、監測及停止條件未核實。【放血】舊點刺出血 unsupported，不執行。【急症邊界】新發或惡化的雙腿無力／感覺改變、鞍區感覺異常、膀胱或腸道功能改變需緊急評估，不作穴位療效證據。【特殊族群】孕期、兒童、抗凝／出血風險無 point-specific protocol。
cautionsEn: [Source conflict] eLotus uses perpendicular 0.5-1.0-cun insertion at midpoint locations; American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 variants use wristward slanted 1-1.5-cun insertion at metacarpal-base articulations; legacy wristward 0.5-0.8-cun insertion is separate. Values must not cross locations. [Local safety gap] Sources give no extensor-tendon, dorsal venous/neurovascular, or interosseous endpoint. [Dynamic-needling gap] Range of lumbar movement, monitoring, and stopping rules are unverified. [Bloodletting] Legacy prick-to-bleed is unsupported and non-executable. [Emergency boundary] New or worsening bilateral leg weakness/sensory change, saddle sensory change, or bladder/bowel dysfunction requires urgent assessment and is not acupuncture-efficacy evidence. [Special populations] No point-specific protocol is available for pregnancy, children, anticoagulation, or bleeding risk.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 對本穴的直接支持集中於急性腰扭傷與利腰；舊慢性腰痛、腰骶痛及配穴不因保留而升格。
American Dragon Yaotong 1／3 只作變體對照；Yaotong 2 的第3、4掌骨間定位不屬本卡兩穴。
clinical_pearls_en: Direct eLotus support centers on acute lumbar sprain and benefiting the lower back; retained chronic pain and combination claims are not promoted.
American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 serve only as variant comparisons; Yaotong 2 between the third and fourth metacarpals is not one of this card's two points.
nameIntroZh: 腰痛點（Yaotongxue，Lumbar Pain Points）為手背雙側各兩穴的經外奇穴；本庫保留 EX-UE7／ex.ue7，並將不同來源的定位與刺法成套分列。
nameIntroEn: Yaotongxue (Lumbar Pain Points) comprises two extra points on each dorsal hand. The database preserves EX-UE7 / ex.ue7 and keeps each source's location and technique paired rather than manufacturing consensus.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Yaotongxue; no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus Ex-UE7 page supplies the midpoint locations, four-point count, acute lumbar sprain indication, lower-back action, and perpendicular 0.5-1.0-cun method. American Dragon's pinyin index has no exact Yaotongxue entry; Yaotong 1 and 3 are retained as partial location/technique variants, while Yaotong 2 is excluded. Legacy 1-cun location, chronic/lumbosacral indications, blood-activating/channel/sinew actions, 0.5-0.8-cun wristward insertion, dynamic movement, bloodletting, and BL40/GV26 combination remain visible at lower or unsupported evidence levels. The NHS cauda equina page supplies an emergency boundary only, not evidence of acupuncture efficacy.

needlingEn: eLotus midpoint locations: perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun. American Dragon Yaotong 1/3 metacarpal-base variants: wristward slanted 1-1.5 cun. Legacy 0.5-0.8-cun dynamic needling is retained historically; prick-to-bleed is unsupported.

location: 手背，第2、3掌骨間，掌指關節後0.5寸處。
locationEn: On dorsum of hand, between 2nd/3rd metacarpals, 0.5 cun proximal to MCP joint.
cunMeasurement: 第2、3掌骨間、掌指關節近端0.5寸，以骨間隙與掌指關節為標誌。
anatomyZh: 位於第2、3掌骨間的手背區。來源未提供皮膚至骨間肌的深度、伸肌腱與手背靜脈／神經血管的精確走向，也未提供以局部痠、痛、麻或向指端傳導作安全終點的判準。舊『前臂神經電擊感』警語與本穴手背定位不相稱，降為 unsupported legacy。
anatomyEn: This point lies in the dorsal region between the second and third metacarpals. Sources do not provide skin-to-interosseous depth, exact extensor-tendon or dorsal venous/neurovascular trajectories, or criteria for treating local soreness, pain, numbness, or fingertip radiation as a safe endpoint. The legacy warning about an 'electric forearm nerve sensation' is anatomically mismatched to this dorsal-hand location and is downgraded as unsupported history.
acumethodZh: eLotus：直刺0.5～0.8寸。American Dragon 落枕穴 exact page：直刺或斜刺0.5～1.0寸，可有局部痛、痠、麻或向指端傳導。舊卡留針轉動頸部未在 exact pages 找到操作幅度、監測或停止條件，保留為 unsupported legacy。
acumethodEn: eLotus: perpendicular insertion 0.5-0.8 cun. The American Dragon Luozhen exact page gives straight or slanted insertion 0.5-1.0 cun and describes local pain, soreness, numbness, or radiation to the fingertips. Legacy retained-needle neck movement lacks verified range, monitoring, and stopping rules on the exact pages and remains unsupported history.
moxaZh: eLotus：可灸3～5分鐘；未說明直接／間接法、距離、皮膚保護或停止條件。American Dragon exact page 未提供灸法規格。
moxaEn: eLotus: moxibustion for 3-5 minutes; direct/indirect method, distance, skin protection, and stopping rules are not specified. The American Dragon exact page provides no moxibustion protocol.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：直刺0.5～0.8寸；灸3～5分鐘。American Dragon 落枕穴：直刺或斜刺0.5～1.0寸。Legacy 留針轉動頸部 unsupported；不把前臂電擊感當安全終點。
eLotus: perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun; moxa 3-5 minutes. American Dragon Luozhen: straight or slanted 0.5-1.0 cun. Legacy retained-needle neck movement is unsupported; forearm electric sensation is not treated as a safety endpoint.
functions: 舒筋通絡；調中理氣；通經活絡、止痛利頸（legacy）
functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews and opens the channels/collaterals; harmonizes the middle and regulates qi; unblocks the channels, alleviates pain, and benefits the neck (legacy)

Harmonizes the middle and regulates qi

pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE8／ex.ue8，外勞宮 Wailaogong，並保留落枕穴 Luozhen 別名。NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Luozhen；eLotus 以 Ex-UE8 列 Wailaogong，且註稱其定位與 Luozhen 相同；American Dragon 以 M-UE-24 列 Luozhen。外部代碼差異不改本庫 id。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE8 / ex.ue8, Wailaogong, with Luozhen retained as an alias. NCBAHM Appendix A lists Luozhen. eLotus codes Wailaogong as Ex-UE8 and notes the same location as Luozhen, while American Dragon codes Luozhen M-UE-24. External code differences do not change the database ID.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 以 Luozhen 名稱明列。考點是外勞宮／落枕穴同位別名關係、手背第2／3掌骨間定位，以及 eLotus 0.5～0.8寸與 American Dragon 0.5～1.0寸兩套刺法。
exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A lists the point as Luozhen. Key study issues are the Wailaogong/Luozhen same-location alias relationship, the dorsal second/third intermetacarpal location, and the separate eLotus 0.5-0.8-cun versus American Dragon 0.5-1.0-cun methods.
exam_pearl: 落枕穴可在 AD 用 Luozhen 找到；不要因 AD 代碼 M-UE-24 或 eLotus 的別名註記而改動本庫 EX-UE8。
exam_pearl_en: American Dragon lists this location under Luozhen. Do not change the database's EX-UE8 identity because American Dragon uses M-UE-24 or because eLotus discusses the alias.
patterns: 手指麻木、紅腫或屈伸不利

alleviate pain and benefit the neck (legacy)

combinePointsEn: American Dragon pairs Luozhen with Xinshi (M-HN-29) for stiff neck. The legacy card separately pairs Wailaogong with Xuanzhong (GB39) and Houxi (SI3); this was not verified on the exact pages and remains unsupported legacy, not an efficacy guarantee.
cautions: 【刺法差異】eLotus 直刺0.5～0.8寸；American Dragon 直刺或斜刺0.5～1.0寸，分開呈現。【局部安全缺口】來源未給伸肌腱、手背靜脈／神經血管、骨間結構的安全終點；AD 所述向指端傳導感不等於已建立的安全停止規則。【動態技法】舊留針轉頸 unsupported；無幅度、監測或停止 protocol。【舊警語】『前臂神經電擊感』與手背定位不相稱，降為 unsupported，不作指引。【兒科急症邊界】eLotus 所列小兒驚厥、臍風／新生兒破傷風只保留為來源主治紀錄；持續或首次發作、呼吸／清醒困難需急救，新生兒破傷風為須住院的急症，均不作穴位療效或 disease tag。【特殊族群】孕期、兒童及感覺／循環異常者無 point-specific protocol。
cautionsEn: [Technique difference] eLotus gives perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun; American Dragon gives straight or slanted 0.5-1.0 cun, retained separately. [Local safety gap] Sources provide no extensor-tendon, dorsal venous/neurovascular, or interosseous endpoint; American Dragon's fingertip-radiating sensation is not an established stopping rule. [Dynamic method] Legacy retained-needle neck rotation is unsupported, with no range, monitoring, or stop protocol. [Legacy warning] 'Electric forearm nerve sensation' is anatomically mismatched and downgraded, not guidance. [Pediatric emergency boundary] eLotus-listed childhood convulsions and neonatal tetanus are retained only as source-reported indications. Prolonged/first seizures or breathing/waking difficulty require emergency help, and neonatal tetanus requires hospitalization; neither is promoted as efficacy or a disease tag. [Special populations] No point-specific protocol is available for pregnancy, children, or sensory/circulatory impairment.
clinical_pearls: 外勞宮與落枕穴在 eLotus 被視為同定位；AD 可用 Luozhen 找到 exact page，但外部編碼不同。
eLotus 的兒科驚厥與新生兒破傷風主治只進 provenance／clinical boundary，不進 disease tags。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus treats Wailaogong and Luozhen as the same location; the American Dragon exact page is found under Luozhen but uses a different external code.
eLotus pediatric convulsion and neonatal-tetanus indications remain in provenance/clinical boundaries and are excluded from disease tags.
nameIntroZh: 外勞宮（Wailaogong，Outer Laogong）為手背經外奇穴，亦稱落枕穴 Luozhen。本庫保留 EX-UE8／ex.ue8，外部別名與編碼差異另列。
nameIntroEn: Wailaogong (Outer Laogong) is a dorsal-hand extra point also called Luozhen. The database preserves EX-UE8 / ex.ue8 while recording external alias and coding differences separately.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A lists Luozhen, and no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus Ex-UE8 page supplies location, hand/neck/head/GI indications, channel/sinew and middle-jiao actions, perpendicular 0.5-0.8-cun insertion, 3-5-minute moxa, and the note that Wailaogong and Luozhen share a location. The exact American Dragon Luozhen page supplies M-UE-24 coding, matching location, straight/slanted 0.5-1.0-cun insertion, stiff-neck/migraine and other indications, and an M-HN-29 Xinshi combination. eLotus pediatric convulsion and neonatal-tetanus claims are retained only in provenance and emergency boundaries. Legacy cervical spondylosis, dorsal hand pain, neck-movement technique, GB39/SI3 combination, and forearm-electric-sensation warning remain at unsupported or lower evidence levels.
