needling: eLotus：直刺0.5～0.8寸。American Dragon 落枕穴：直刺或斜刺0.5～1.0寸。舊留針轉頸 unsupported。
needlingEn: eLotus: perpendicular 0.5-0.8 cun. American Dragon Luozhen: straight or slanted 0.5-1.0 cun. Legacy retained-needle neck movement is unsupported.

location: 微握拳，手背各指蹼後方赤白肉際、掌骨頭之間凹陷處；每手4穴，雙手共8穴。
locationEn: With a loose fist, on the dorsum of the hand at the red-white skin junction behind each interdigital web and between the metacarpal heads; four points per hand, eight total.
cunMeasurement: 以四個指蹼後方赤白肉際及掌骨頭間凹陷定位，不使用骨度分寸；每手4穴。
anatomyZh: 位於手背四個指蹼與掌骨頭間的表淺區域。eLotus 與 American Dragon 未提供各蹼間指背／掌側神經血管、伸肌腱分支、骨間肌或皮膚至安全終點的逐點解剖；American Dragon 所述向指端放射的痠脹／電感是來源記載，不等於已驗證的安全終點。
anatomyEn: The points occupy superficial dorsal regions behind the four interdigital webs and between the metacarpal heads. eLotus and American Dragon do not provide point-by-point dorsal/palmar digital neurovascular, extensor-slip, interosseous, or skin-to-endpoint anatomy. American Dragon's described distention, soreness, or electric radiation to the fingertips is a source-reported response, not a validated safety endpoint.
acumethodZh: eLotus：斜刺0.3～0.5寸，或點刺出血。American Dragon：可沿掌骨方向直刺至1寸；另列直刺0.5～1.0寸，或斜刺0.3～0.5寸／點刺出血。舊卡斜刺0.5～0.8寸及直刺0.5～1.0寸保留為 legacy；不得把不同方向與深度合成單一技法。放血未提供器械、出血量、止血或追蹤規格。
acumethodEn: eLotus: oblique insertion 0.3-0.5 cun or prick-to-bleed. American Dragon: straight insertion along the metacarpal up to 1 cun; it also lists perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun or oblique 0.3-0.5 cun/prick-to-bleed. Legacy oblique 0.5-0.8 cun and perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun are retained historically; differing directions and depths are not merged into one method. Bloodletting lacks device, blood-quantity, hemostasis, and follow-up parameters.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 均記可灸，但未提供壯數、時間、距離、直接／間接法、皮膚保護或停止條件；不自行補數字。
moxaEn: Both eLotus and American Dragon state that moxibustion is applicable, but provide no cone count, duration, distance, direct/indirect method, skin protection, or stopping rule; no numeric protocol is inferred.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：斜刺0.3～0.5寸，或點刺出血；可灸但無劑量。American Dragon：沿掌骨方向直刺至1寸，或直刺0.5～1.0寸，或斜刺0.3～0.5寸／點刺出血；可灸但無劑量。Legacy 斜刺0.5～0.8寸另列。
eLotus: oblique 0.3-0.5 cun or prick-to-bleed; moxa applicable without dose. American Dragon: straight along the metacarpal up to 1 cun, perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun, or oblique 0.3-0.5 cun/prick-to-bleed; moxa without dose. Legacy oblique 0.5-0.8 cun remains separate.
functions: 舒筋通絡，祛風濕，活血，清熱消腫；清熱解毒、通絡止痛（legacy）
functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews and opens the channels/collaterals; expels wind-damp, invigorates blood, clears heat, and dissipates swelling; clears heat/resolves toxin and unblocks collaterals to alleviate pain (legacy)
functionsEnList: Relaxes the sinews and opens the channels/collaterals
pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE9／ex.ue9，八邪 Baxie。NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Baxie；eLotus 為 Ex-UE9；American Dragon 以 M-UE-22 列 Baxie。外部代碼不同不改本庫 id。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE9 / ex.ue9, Baxie. NCBAHM Appendix A lists Baxie; eLotus uses Ex-UE9 and American Dragon uses M-UE-22. The differing external code does not change the database ID.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列八邪。需掌握每手4穴、雙手8穴的指蹼赤白肉際定位，並把斜刺、沿掌骨直刺、點刺出血與無劑量灸法分開記。
exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Baxie. Know the four points per hand/eight total at the web-margin red-white junction, and keep oblique insertion, straight insertion along the metacarpal, prick-to-bleed, and dose-unspecified moxa as separate methods.
exam_pearl: 『八』指雙手共8穴；放血是來源技法，但來源沒有出血量與止血 protocol，不能因 validator 看見 bloodletting 字樣就當作臨床已驗證。
exam_pearl_en: 'Eight' means eight points across both hands. Bloodletting is source-reported, but the sources give no blood quantity or hemostasis protocol; validator recognition of the method does not make it clinically verified.
patterns: 手指痙攣／拘急或屈伸不利
毒蛇咬傷（AD來源主治；急症邊界）
patternsEn: Red, swollen, painful dorsum of hand
combinePointsZh: American Dragon 記【手指麻木】八邪配外關（SJ5）。其另記瘧疾以八邪放血，僅保留於來源層，因無 point-specific 放血量與安全 protocol，不作本卡配穴或 disease tag。
combinePointsEn: American Dragon pairs Baxie with Waiguan (SJ5) for finger numbness. Its separate note on bleeding Baxie for malaria is retained only in provenance; without point-specific blood quantity and safety parameters, it is not promoted as a card combination or disease tag.
cautions: 【多套刺法】eLotus 斜刺0.3～0.5寸；AD 另有沿掌骨直刺至1寸、直刺0.5～1.0寸及斜刺0.3～0.5寸；舊斜刺0.5～0.8寸分列，不製造假共識。【局部解剖缺口】來源未給各蹼間神經血管、伸肌腱分支、骨間肌或皮膚至安全終點；向指端放射的痠脹／電感不是已驗證停止規則。【放血缺口】器械、消毒、出血量、止血、感染監測、抗凝／出血風險、孕期與兒童 protocol 均未提供，不得猜。【毒蛇咬傷】AD 所列主治只作來源紀錄；CDC 要求立即急救，不等待症狀，且不可綁止血帶、切割／吸吮或冰敷，本卡不把蛇咬傷當穴位療效證據。【其他重大主治】AD 所列壞疽、發熱病與瘧疾放血只留 provenance，不進 disease tags。
cautionsEn: [Multiple techniques] eLotus gives oblique 0.3-0.5 cun; American Dragon separately gives straight insertion along the metacarpal up to 1 cun, perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun, and oblique 0.3-0.5 cun; legacy oblique 0.5-0.8 cun remains separate, without false consensus. [Local anatomy gap] Sources give no interdigital neurovascular, extensor-slip, interosseous, or skin-to-endpoint detail; fingertip-radiating distention/electric sensation is not a validated stopping rule. [Bloodletting gap] Device, antisepsis, blood quantity, hemostasis, infection monitoring, anticoagulation/bleeding risk, pregnancy, and pediatric protocols are absent and must not be guessed. [Venomous snakebite] The American Dragon indication is source-reported only. CDC calls for immediate emergency care without waiting for symptoms and advises against tourniquets, cutting/suction, or ice; the card does not treat snakebite as acupuncture-efficacy evidence. [Other major claims] American Dragon gangrene, febrile-disease, and malaria-bloodletting claims remain in provenance and are excluded from disease tags.
clinical_pearls: 八邪的定位與常見手部主治在 eLotus 與 AD 高度一致；主要差異在刺入方向、深度及 AD 額外主治範圍。
蛇咬傷、壞疽、發熱病與瘧疾放血不因出現在來源而升格為療效或 disease tag。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus and American Dragon largely agree on location and common hand indications; the main differences are insertion direction/depth and American Dragon's broader indication list.
Snakebite, gangrene, febrile disease, and malaria bloodletting are not promoted to efficacy claims or disease tags merely because a source lists them.
nameIntroZh: 八邪（Baxie，Eight Evils）為雙手指蹼後方共8穴的經外奇穴。本庫保留 EX-UE9／ex.ue9，並把針刺、放血與灸法的來源規格分開呈現。
nameIntroEn: Baxie (Eight Evils) comprises eight extra points behind the interdigital webs of both hands. The database preserves EX-UE9 / ex.ue9 and presents source-specific needling, bloodletting, and moxibustion methods separately.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Baxie; no dedicated local curriculum entry was found. The exact eLotus Ex-UE9 page contributes the eight-point web-margin location, excessive-heat/hand indications, heat/swelling actions, oblique 0.3-0.5-cun or prick-to-bleed methods, and dose-unspecified moxa. The exact American Dragon Baxie page contributes M-UE-22 coding, concordant location, broader sinew/wind-damp/blood/heat actions, multiple needling methods, prick-to-bleed and moxa, the SJ5 combination, and broader indications. Snakebite, gangrene, febrile disease, and malaria bloodletting remain source-reported claims with safety boundaries, not efficacy tags. Legacy 0.5-0.8-cun oblique insertion and toxin/pain language are preserved separately. The CDC snake page supplies emergency first-aid boundaries only.

needlingEn: eLotus: oblique 0.3-0.5 cun or prick-to-bleed. American Dragon: straight along the metacarpal up to 1 cun, perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun, or oblique 0.3-0.5 cun/prick-to-bleed. Legacy oblique 0.5-0.8 cun remains separate.

location: 手掌面，食指、中指、無名指與小指近端指間關節（PIP）屈側橫紋中央；AD 補充以屈指時最明顯的橫紋為準。
locationEn: On the palmar surface, at the midpoint of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) flexion creases of the index, middle, ring, and little fingers. American Dragon specifies the crease that is most prominent on flexion.
cunMeasurement: 以第2～5指 PIP 屈側最明顯橫紋中央定位，不另用骨度分寸。
anatomyZh: 定位在第2～5指 PIP 屈側橫紋。eLotus 與 American Dragon 未提供皮膚、指腹、屈肌腱／腱鞘、關節囊與指神經血管的逐指層次或安全終點；『擠出黃白色黏液』是來源技法描述，不等於組織層次或成功／停止判準。
anatomyEn: The points lie at the palmar PIP creases of digits 2-5. eLotus and American Dragon provide no digit-specific layers or endpoints for skin, pulp, flexor tendon/sheath, joint capsule, or digital neurovascular structures. Expressing yellowish viscous fluid is a source-described method, not an anatomical layer or validated success/stopping criterion.
acumethodZh: eLotus：點刺使出血，或局部擠出少量黃白色黏液。American Dragon：點刺出血，或針刺後擠出少量黃白色黏液，並註即使沒有液體流出亦可。兩頁都未給針具規格、刺入深度、每穴出血／擠液量、處理穴數、止血或追蹤。舊『三稜針』器械名稱保留為 unverified legacy，不升格為 canonical 器械。
acumethodEn: eLotus: prick to cause bleeding or express a small amount of yellowish viscous fluid locally. American Dragon: prick to bleed, or needle and then express a small amount of yellowish viscous fluid, noting that the method may still be used if no fluid appears. Neither page specifies device, insertion depth, per-point blood/fluid quantity, number of points treated, hemostasis, or follow-up. The legacy 'three-edged needle' device remains unverified history and is not promoted as the canonical instrument.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon exact pages 均未提供四縫灸法。舊卡同時出現『禁灸』與『可灸』互相矛盾的 legacy 值；兩者均無精確來源支持，不進 canonical technique，也不自行判定可灸或禁灸。
moxaEn: Neither the eLotus nor American Dragon exact page supplies a Sifeng moxibustion method. The legacy card contains mutually contradictory 'moxibustion prohibited' and 'moxibustion applicable' values; neither has exact-source support, so neither enters canonical technique and no permission/prohibition is inferred.
techniqueNotes:
Canonical source record：點刺出血，或針刺／點刺後擠出少量黃白色黏液；無核實深度、器械、每穴量或止血 protocol。Legacy 三稜針、禁灸及可灸互相矛盾且 unsupported。
Canonical source record: prick to bleed, or needle/prick and express a small amount of yellowish viscous fluid; no verified depth, device, per-point quantity, or hemostasis protocol. Legacy three-edged needle and contradictory moxa prohibition/permission are unsupported.
functions: 健脾，消積；祛風、除濕、促進消化；和胃、消疳（legacy）
functionsEn: Strengthens the Spleen and dissipates accumulation; expels wind, resolves dampness, and promotes digestion; harmonizes the Stomach and eliminates Gan syndrome (legacy)
functionsEnList: Harmonizes the Stomach and eliminates Gan syndrome (legacy)
pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE10／ex.ue10，四縫 Sifeng。NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Sifeng；eLotus 為 Ex-UE10，American Dragon 為 M-UE-9。外部代碼差異不改本庫 id。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE10 / ex.ue10, Sifeng. NCBAHM Appendix A lists Sifeng; eLotus codes it Ex-UE10 and American Dragon M-UE-9. The external code difference does not change the database ID.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列四縫。考點是第2～5指 PIP 屈側橫紋中央及兒童消化／疳積主治；侵入性技法只能記為來源所述點刺／擠少量黏液，不補猜深度與放血量。
exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Sifeng. Know the palmar PIP-crease midpoints of digits 2-5 and the pediatric digestive/malnutrition indications. Record the invasive method only as source-described pricking/expression of a small amount of fluid; do not invent depth or bleeding quantity.
exam_pearl: 四縫在四個非拇指的 PIP 屈側橫紋；『擠出黃白色液體』是來源技法，不是必須達成的安全終點。舊可灸／禁灸互相打架，兩者都不升格。
exam_pearl_en: Sifeng lies at the palmar PIP creases of the four non-thumb digits. Expressing yellowish fluid is a source-described method, not a mandatory safety endpoint. Conflicting legacy moxa permission/prohibition is not promoted.
patterns: 百日咳（來源主治；感染／呼吸邊界）
腸道蛔蟲（來源主治；不作單獨治療證據）
combinePointsZh: American Dragon 記兩組：【百日咳】四縫配內關（PC6）、合谷（LI4）；【小兒消化不良】四縫配內關（PC6）、合谷（LI4）、足三里（ST36）。配穴表已按欄位核對，但不取代百日咳的感染與呼吸評估。
combinePointsEn: American Dragon lists two combinations: for pertussis, Sifeng with Neiguan (PC6) and Hegu (LI4); for infantile indigestion, Sifeng with Neiguan (PC6), Hegu (LI4), and Zusanli (ST36). The table columns were checked, but the combination does not replace infection or respiratory assessment for pertussis.
cautions: 【兒童侵入性技法】兩 exact pages 僅記點刺出血／擠少量黃白色黏液，未給針具、深度、每穴量、總穴數、無菌、止血、包紮、感染監測或何時停止擠壓；不得猜。【局部解剖缺口】未給屈肌腱／腱鞘、關節囊與指神經血管安全終點。【灸法衝突】舊『禁灸』與『可灸』互相矛盾且均無 exact support，兩者皆不執行為 canonical 規則。【特殊族群】嬰幼兒年齡下限、抗凝／出血異常、免疫低下、感覺異常與孕期均無 point-specific protocol。【百日咳邊界】來源列百日咳不等於穴位療效已驗證；嬰兒可能不咳而出現呼吸暫停、發紺或呼吸困難，CDC 建議呼吸困難立即就醫。
cautionsEn: [Pediatric invasive method] The exact pages only state prick-to-bleed/express a small amount of yellowish viscous fluid and give no device, depth, per-point quantity, total point count, asepsis, hemostasis, dressing, infection monitoring, or stopping rule; none may be guessed. [Local anatomy gap] No flexor tendon/sheath, joint-capsule, or digital neurovascular endpoint is supplied. [Moxa conflict] Legacy 'prohibited' and 'applicable' values contradict each other and lack exact support; neither is executable canonical guidance. [Special populations] No point-specific protocol covers infant age thresholds, anticoagulation/bleeding disorders, immunosuppression, sensory impairment, or pregnancy. [Pertussis boundary] A source listing is not verified acupuncture efficacy. Infants may have apnea, cyanosis, or breathing difficulty without a typical cough; CDC advises immediate care for breathing difficulty.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD 對定位、兒童消化主治及點刺／擠液方法高度一致；AD 額外列手指關節炎、蛔蟲與小兒腹瀉。
兒童卡的高品質重點是保留來源技法，同時讓所有缺失的器械、量、止血與感染控制保持可見。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus and American Dragon closely agree on location, pediatric digestive indications, and pricking/fluid-expression methods; American Dragon additionally lists finger arthritis, roundworms, and childhood diarrhea.
For a pediatric card, quality means retaining the source method while keeping absent device, quantity, hemostasis, and infection-control parameters visible.
nameIntroZh: 四縫（Sifeng，Four Seams）為第2～5指掌側 PIP 橫紋的經外奇穴。本庫保留 EX-UE10／ex.ue10，並將兒童點刺／擠液技法與未解安全參數分開呈現。
nameIntroEn: Sifeng (Four Seams) is an extra-point group at the palmar PIP creases of digits 2-5. The database preserves EX-UE10 / ex.ue10 and separates the pediatric pricking/fluid-expression method from unresolved safety parameters.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Sifeng; no dedicated local curriculum lesson was found. The exact eLotus Ex-UE10 page contributes location, childhood malnutrition/indigestion and pertussis indications, Spleen/accumulation actions, and prick-to-bleed or small-fluid-expression technique. The exact American Dragon M-UE-9 page adds the flexion-crease clarification, wind/damp/digestion actions, finger arthritis, roundworms and childhood diarrhea indications, and two checked combinations. Both exact pages omit moxa; the legacy card's contradictory prohibited/applicable moxa values and unverified three-edged-needle label remain excluded from canonical technique. CDC pertussis guidance supplies an infant respiratory boundary only, not acupuncture-efficacy evidence.

location: 雙手十指尖端，距指甲約0.1寸，共10穴。eLotus 與 American Dragon 均使用此定位。
locationEn: At the tips of the ten fingers, approximately 0.1 cun from the nails, for ten points in total. eLotus and American Dragon use the same location.
cunMeasurement: 以每一指尖距指甲約0.1寸為定位標誌；此0.1寸是定位距離，不是自動等同刺入深度。
anatomyZh: 位於十指末端、近指甲區。兩 exact pages 未提供指腹、甲床／甲基質、末節指骨、指神經血管或皮膚至安全終點的逐指解剖；舊『避開肱動脈與神經』與指尖定位明顯不相稱，降為 unsupported legacy。
anatomyEn: The points lie at the distal fingertips near the nails. The exact pages provide no digit-specific anatomy for pulp, nail bed/matrix, distal phalanx, digital neurovascular structures, or skin-to-endpoint depth. The legacy warning to avoid the brachial artery and nerves is anatomically mismatched to fingertip locations and is downgraded as unsupported history.
acumethodZh: eLotus：淺刺0.1～0.2寸，或點刺出血。American Dragon：同列淺刺0.1～0.2寸或點刺出血。舊卡三稜針器械名稱無 exact-page 支持，保留為 unverified legacy；舊直刺0.5～1.0寸遠深於兩頁數值，排除於 canonical technique。
acumethodEn: eLotus: superficial puncture 0.1-0.2 cun or prick-to-bleed. American Dragon gives the same superficial 0.1-0.2-cun or prick-to-bleed options. The legacy three-edged-needle device lacks exact-page support and remains unverified history; legacy perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun is far deeper than both exact pages and is excluded from canonical technique.
moxaZh: American Dragon 記點刺出血後可接續灸法，但未提供壯數、時間、距離、直接／間接法、皮膚保護或停止規則；eLotus 未列灸法。不可把 AD 的條件式陳述擴張為無條件『可灸』。
moxaEn: American Dragon states that prick-to-bleed may be followed by moxibustion but gives no cone count, duration, distance, direct/indirect method, skin protection, or stopping rule. eLotus lists no moxa. The conditional American Dragon statement must not be expanded into unconditional 'moxibustion applicable.'
techniqueNotes:
eLotus／AD：淺刺0.1～0.2寸，或點刺出血。AD 另記放血後可接灸，但無灸量。Legacy 三稜針與直刺0.5～1.0寸 unsupported；放血量、止血與感染監測均未提供。
eLotus/AD: superficial puncture 0.1-0.2 cun or prick-to-bleed. AD additionally permits post-bleeding moxa without a dose. Legacy three-edged needle and 0.5-1.0-cun insertion are unsupported; blood quantity, hemostasis, and infection monitoring are absent.
functions: 開竅醒神，清熱，息風；回陽救逆（legacy）
functionsEn: Opens the orifices and revives consciousness; drains heat; pacifies/expels wind; restores yang and rescues collapse (legacy)
pointIdentityZh: 本庫穩定代碼 EX-UE11／ex.ue11，十宣 Shixuan。NCBAHM Appendix A 明列 Shixuan；eLotus 為 Ex-UE11，American Dragon 為 M-UE-1。外部代碼差異不改本庫 id。
pointIdentityEn: Stable database identity: EX-UE11 / ex.ue11, Shixuan. NCBAHM Appendix A lists Shixuan; eLotus codes it Ex-UE11 and American Dragon M-UE-1. The external code difference does not change the database ID.
exam_importance: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A 明列十宣。考點是十指尖、距甲約0.1寸、淺刺0.1～0.2寸或點刺出血；來源雖列多種昏迷／中風／高熱急症，但卡片必須同步顯示緊急醫療邊界。
exam_importance_en: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Shixuan. Know the ten fingertip points about 0.1 cun from the nails and the superficial 0.1-0.2-cun or prick-to-bleed methods. Although sources list coma, stroke, and febrile emergencies, the card must show emergency-care boundaries alongside those claims.
exam_pearl: 定位0.1寸與刺深0.1～0.2寸是兩個不同數字；舊0.5～1.0寸深刺不可沿用。十宣常被列作急救穴，但『來源列主治』不等於可以延誤 EMS。
exam_pearl_en: The 0.1-cun location distance and 0.1-0.2-cun insertion depth are distinct values; legacy 0.5-1.0-cun deep insertion is not retained. Shixuan is often listed as an emergency point, but a source indication never justifies delaying EMS.

combinePointsZh: American Dragon 記【高熱所致熱衰竭】十宣配大椎（GV14）、耳尖（M-HN-10）；表格欄位已核對。此配穴只保留為來源記載，不取代熱射病快速降溫與 EMS。
combinePointsEn: American Dragon pairs Shixuan with Dazhui (GV14) and Erjian (M-HN-10) for heat exhaustion due to high fever; the table columns were checked. This remains a source-reported combination and does not replace rapid cooling and EMS for heatstroke.
cautions: 【深度】兩 exact pages 僅支持淺刺0.1～0.2寸或點刺出血；舊直刺0.5～1.0寸 unsupported，不執行。【指尖解剖缺口】未給甲床／甲基質、指腹、末節指骨或指神經血管安全終點；舊肱動脈警語與定位不相稱。【放血缺口】器械、每穴出血量、十穴是否全做、無菌、止血、包紮、感染監測、抗凝／出血風險與兒童 protocol 未提供。【灸法】只有 AD 條件式『放血後可灸』且無任何劑量／皮膚保護，不作一般可灸規則。【急症】疑似中風應立即撥打911；熱射病需立即 EMS 與快速降溫；發作超過5分鐘、反覆發作、呼吸／清醒困難或首次發作需911。上述只作 emergency boundary，不是穴位療效證據。
cautionsEn: [Depth] Both exact pages support only superficial 0.1-0.2-cun puncture or prick-to-bleed; legacy perpendicular 0.5-1.0 cun is unsupported and non-executable. [Fingertip anatomy gap] No nail-bed/matrix, pulp, distal-phalanx, or digital-neurovascular endpoint is given; the legacy brachial-artery warning is anatomically mismatched. [Bloodletting gap] Device, per-point blood quantity, whether all ten points are treated, asepsis, hemostasis, dressing, infection monitoring, anticoagulation/bleeding risk, and pediatric protocols are absent. [Moxa] Only American Dragon conditionally allows post-bleeding moxa and gives no dose or skin protection; this is not general permission. [Emergencies] Suspected stroke requires immediate 911 activation; heatstroke requires EMS and rapid cooling; seizures over 5 minutes, repeated seizures, breathing/waking difficulty, or a first seizure require 911. These are emergency boundaries, not acupuncture-efficacy evidence.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 與 AD 對十指尖定位、0.1～0.2寸淺刺／放血及開竅清熱息風高度一致；AD 額外列條件式放血後灸法。
急救主治保留來源層，但 stroke、heatstroke、seizure 的 EMS 邊界必須比療效主張更醒目。
clinical_pearls_en: eLotus and American Dragon closely agree on fingertip location, superficial 0.1-0.2-cun/prick-to-bleed methods, and orifice/heat/wind actions; American Dragon additionally lists conditional post-bleeding moxa.
Emergency indications remain in provenance, but EMS boundaries for stroke, heatstroke, and seizures must be more prominent than efficacy claims.
nameIntroZh: 十宣（Shixuan，Ten Diffusions）為雙手十指尖共10穴的經外奇穴。本庫保留 EX-UE11／ex.ue11，並將淺刺／放血技法與急症邊界同時呈現。
nameIntroEn: Shixuan (Ten Diffusions) comprises ten extra points at the fingertips of both hands. The database preserves EX-UE11 / ex.ue11 and presents the superficial puncture/bloodletting methods together with emergency boundaries.
evidence: NCBAHM 2026 ACPL Appendix A explicitly lists Shixuan; no dedicated local curriculum lesson was found. The exact eLotus Ex-UE11 page contributes location, acute neurologic/febrile/throat/fingertip indications, orifice/consciousness/heat/wind actions, and superficial 0.1-0.2-cun or prick-to-bleed techniques. The exact American Dragon M-UE-1 page substantially concurs, adds a conditional post-bleeding moxa statement and a checked GV14/M-HN-10 combination, and lists broader acute indications. Legacy three-edged-needle wording, 0.5-1.0-cun deep insertion, unconditional moxa, and brachial-artery warning are unsupported or anatomically mismatched. CDC stroke, heat-illness, and seizure pages supply emergency boundaries only, not evidence of acupuncture efficacy.
